media_break_in.title: The Media Break-In
media_break_in.beats:
Lunch hour at U.A. Academy on the day Class 1-A settles its class representative. By canon default Izuku Midoriya won the vote by a hair with Momo Yaoyorozu as deputy, unless the story's own vote went otherwise; Tenya Iida, who voted for someone other than himself, eats with Ochaco Uraraka in Lunch Rush's Cafeteria. Reporters have camped at the Main Gate all week for a word with All Might, and the U.A. Barrier keeps them out. Then the Barrier crumbles to dust, the press floods onto the grounds and the campus alarm sounds a level-three breach. The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the cafeteria stampedes for one exit and students are crushed against the corridor windows until Tenya, lifted by Ochaco's Zero Gravity, fires his Engine over the crowd, lands above the exit and shouts that it is only the press. Shota Aizawa and Present Mic hold the reporters back until police arrive. That afternoon, by canon default, the winner hands the representative post to Tenya after seeing him lead. Under cover of the chaos, Tomura Shigaraki and Kurogiri slip in and take the timetable for Class 1-A's rescue training; nobody notices the missing pages today. Unless the player intervenes, Principal Nezu and Aizawa study the dust at the gate and decide no reporter did that.

At U.A. Academy, a student party lives the stampede and can calm it, pull out the crushed or follow the dust to the gate; a faculty or pro party holds the gate and the press; a civilian party can be one of the reporters. A villain party on campus risks Aizawa's stare, which shuts Quirks off. At the League Hideout Bar, a villain party sees the job from the other side: Kurogiri opens a gate for Tomura into the noon crowd, and the stolen pages land on the Bar Counter that evening while Shigaraki's Sensei approves from the dark monitor.

The event is complete when the press is off campus and the crowd is calm, or the party leaves the scene of the breach.

usj_attack.title: The USJ Attack
usj_attack.beats:
Early afternoon at the Unforeseen Simulation Joint (USJ), after lunch. Class 1-A's rescue lesson opens on the Entrance Plaza: Thirteen explains how easily a Quirk can kill, Shota Aizawa stands by, and All Might is delayed at U.A. Academy. Black mist opens over the Central Plaza, bringing Tomura Shigaraki, Kurogiri, hired thugs and the USJ Nomu to kill All Might.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Kurogiri scatters the class into disaster zones. Izuku Midoriya, Tsuyu Asui and Minoru Mineta land in the Flood Zone; Katsuki Bakugo and Eijiro Kirishima in the Ruins Zone; Shoto Todoroki in the Landslide Zone; Momo Yaoyorozu, Kyoka Jiro and Denki Kaminari in the Mountain Zone. Unless the player changes the fighting, Aizawa holds the Central Plaza until the Nomu breaks both his arms and fractures his orbit; Kurogiri redirects Thirteen's Black Hole into her back, tearing it open. Tenya Iida escapes to summon help. Yuga Aoyama hides near the Central Plaza throughout the fight. By canon default All Might arrives and rescues Aizawa and the threatened students. Katsuki pins Kurogiri by his solid metal neck guard, Shoto freezes part of the Nomu, and Eijiro attacks Shigaraki. The Nomu regenerates; All Might drives it through the dome roof. His fighting time then runs out, leaving him bluffing as Shigaraki advances. Unless the player changes the climax, Izuku leaps in to protect him, the faculty arrive with Tenya, Snipe shoots Shigaraki, and Shigaraki and Kurogiri escape. Police arrest the remaining thugs. Aizawa and Thirteen go directly to the hospital; Recovery Girl treats the students.

Kurogiri's interference cuts the dome's communications; the main campus gets no breach alarm. A party in U.A. Academy's Faculty Office first hears the attack from Tenya and can help bring the response sooner. Class 1-A students fight where the mist drops them; other U.A. courses remain on campus unless the story gives them a route. Faculty, pros and sidekicks join the rescue. Villains can enter as hired muscle from the League Hideout Bar; Shigaraki and Kurogiri return there last, Shigaraki wounded and raging at his Sensei's monitor. Civilians meet police and ambulances on the road to the USJ. Injured parties keep their condition and receive aid.

The event is complete when the attackers have escaped or been captured, the faculty hold the dome, and the wounded are in medical care.

sports_festival.title: The U.A. Sports Festival
sports_festival.beats:
Festival morning at U.A. Stadium, broadcast nationwide. Agency scouts fill the stands; Present Mic and Shota Aizawa call the events, Nemuri Kayama referees and Cementoss raises the stage. Students come from U.A. Academy's dorms to the Competitor Waiting Rooms.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Shoto Todoroki declares war on Izuku Midoriya in the waiting room; Katsuki Bakugo pledges to win and draws boos. Unless the player changes the races, Izuku wins the obstacle course of robots, a chasm and mines by riding a mine blast; Shoto's cavalry team takes his top headband, and Izuku's team barely qualifies. At lunch Shoto privately tells Izuku about Endeavor's treatment of his family and his mother's breakdown; this stays between those present. By canon default Mashirao Ojiro and Nirengeki Shoda withdraw rather than accept advancement earned under Hitoshi Shinso's brainwashing; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu and Ibara Shiozaki replace them after Itsuka Kendo yields her team's opportunity.

Unless the player changes the bracket, Izuku answers Shinso and is brainwashed; One For All's vestiges move his fingers, breaking control, and he wins. That inner encounter stays private. Shoto beats Hanta Sero; Ibara beats Denki Kaminari; Mei Hatsume uses Tenya Iida to advertise her gear, then steps out and gives him the win; Mina Ashido beats Yuga Aoyama; Fumikage Tokoyami beats Momo Yaoyorozu; Eijiro Kirishima and Tetsutetsu draw, then Eijiro wins their arm-wrestling tiebreak; Katsuki beats Ochaco Uraraka despite her falling-debris plan. By canon default Shoto beats Izuku, whose broken fingers and appeal push him to use fire; Tenya beats Ibara, Fumikage beats Mina and Katsuki beats Eijiro. Shoto then beats Tenya, Katsuki beats Fumikage, and Katsuki wins the final when Shoto holds back his fire. Tenya leaves for Hosu after his semifinal on learning that Stain has gravely injured his brother Tensei Iida; unless changed elsewhere, Tensei loses the use of his legs and his hero career. All Might awards medals; Katsuki protests his hollow victory.

A first-year student party from Hero, General Studies, Support or Management competes through its actual qualifiers; injured students keep their condition and can watch. Recovery Girl treats injuries, and stopped opponents are not struck. Faculty staff U.A. Stadium's safety line; pros and sidekicks scout; civilians use the Concourse Food Stalls and stands. Villains watch a broadcast or risk stadium security in disguise. Others follow the dorm lounge screens.

The event is complete when the tournament final is decided and the medal ceremony ends.

hero_names.title: Hero Name Day
hero_names.beats:
Friday morning at U.A. Academy, the first school day after the Sports Festival and its two days off. Strangers recognized the Hero Course on the train in, and Class 1-A Homeroom is loud with it until Shota Aizawa walks in. Today's Foundational Hero Studies is code names: the agencies' internship offers have been tallied, and before anyone picks an agency, every student needs a hero name to put on the paperwork. He hands the judging to Nemuri Kayama, who sweeps in delighted, warns that a careless name can follow a hero for a whole career, and hands out whiteboards. Aizawa retreats to his sleeping bag in the corner.

The offer board goes up first. It follows the Festival as it was actually played; by canon default Shoto Todoroki leads with 4,123 offers and Katsuki Bakugo has 3,556, then Fumikage Tokoyami 360, Tenya Iida 301, Denki Kaminari 272, Momo Yaoyorozu 108, Eijiro Kirishima 68, Ochaco Uraraka 20 and Hanta Sero 14; the rest have none. The canon default names, as pressure the player can change: Yuga Aoyama's I Cannot Stop Twinkling (Nemuri Kayama trims it to Can't Stop Twinkling), Mina Ashido's Alien Queen (rejected; she becomes Pinky), Tsuyu Asui's Froppy, Eijiro Kirishima's Red Riot, Kyoka Jiro's Earphone Jack, Mezo Shoji's Tentacole, Hanta Sero's Cellophane, Mashirao Ojiro's Tailman, Rikido Sato's Sugarman, Denki Kaminari's Chargebolt, Toru Hagakure's Invisible Girl, Momo Yaoyorozu's Creati, Shoto Todoroki's own given name Shoto, Fumikage Tokoyami's Tsukuyomi, Minoru Mineta's Grape Juice, Koji Koda's Anima and Ochaco Uraraka's Uravity. Tenya Iida, quiet since his brother was hurt, writes only Tenya. Katsuki Bakugo's King Explosion Murder and Lord Explosion Murder are both sent back. Izuku Midoriya goes last and takes Deku, turning the insult around.

A student party presents its own name at the lectern: the player chooses it, and Nemuri Kayama approves it or sends it back once with a crisp reason. Once approved, it is the name heroes, staff and the press use for that student on duty. After lunch Nemuri Kayama takes Class 1-B for the same lesson with Vlad King; Itsuka Kendo becomes Battle Fist.

The event is complete when every student in the room has presented a name and the internship lists are handed out, or the party leaves the homeroom.

hosu_incident.title: The Hosu Incident
hosu_incident.beats:
Internship week, evening in Hosu. Tenya Iida slips away from the Manual Hero Agency's patrol to hunt Stain, the Hero Killer who injured his brother. Izuku Midoriya travels with Gran Torino after training at Gran Torino's Apartment; he now uses Full Cowl to spread his power through his body. The League releases three Nomu into Hosu Downtown, drawing local pros and Endeavor, whose intern Shoto Todoroki accompanies him.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: a Nomu crashes into Izuku and Gran Torino's train, interrupting their journey. Izuku leaves Gran Torino fighting and searches the Hosu Back Alleys. There Stain has wounded Native and immobilized him by tasting his blood; Tenya confronts Stain and is also paralyzed. Unless the player changes their arrival, Izuku finds them, sends his location to his classmates and uses Full Cowl to keep Stain occupied. Shoto follows the message. By canon default the three students overcome Stain together, despite his Bloodcurdle and their injuries. The Hosu Winged Nomu then snatches Izuku; Stain frees himself enough to kill it and save him. Bound and bleeding, Stain denounces false heroes before the arriving pros, freezes even Endeavor with his conviction, and loses consciousness on his feet. Unless the player changes the aftermath, police take him into custody and the Nomu are defeated. At Hosu General Hospital, police chief Kenji Tsuragamae explains that the students' unlicensed use of force broke the law; Endeavor receives official credit. Doctors can repair the damage to Tenya's left hand with surgery, but he chooses to leave it as a reminder of his failure and vengeance.

A student party at the Manual Hero Agency can notice Tenya missing; one at Gran Torino's Apartment can travel with Izuku and his mentor. Other students, including other U.A. courses, need an established reason to be in Hosu and do not gain a license by intervening. Pros and sidekicks fight Nomu on Main Street or reach the alleys; faculty coordinate with U.A. Academy and the hospital. A villain party can watch with Tomura Shigaraki and Kurogiri from a rooftop, seeing Stain reject the League's aims. Civilians shelter near Hosu Station or help people away from fires. Wounded characters remain reachable for rescue and hospital treatment.

The event is complete when Stain is in custody or has escaped, the Nomu threat has ended, and the wounded have reached medical care.

final_exams.title: The Final Exams
final_exams.beats:
Early July at U.A. Academy. Class 1-A and Class 1-B sit written papers in their homerooms; Momo Yaoyorozu runs study sessions for classmates at risk of failing. For the practical, Principal Nezu announces pairs against faculty instead of robots. A pair passes by cuffing its teacher or getting one partner through the exit within thirty minutes. Teachers wear weights equal to half their body weight. Gym Gamma is the staging hall, with waiting pairs watching the feeds.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Eijiro Kirishima and Rikido Sato exhaust themselves against Cementoss and fail; Tsuyu Asui and Fumikage Tokoyami combine their abilities against Ectoplasm and pass. Tenya Iida and Mashirao Ojiro pass against Power Loader by using their movement together to reach the exit despite his traps. Shoto Todoroki and Momo pass against Shota Aizawa through Momo's plan, with Shoto learning to trust her judgment. Unless the player changes the remaining practicals, Ochaco Uraraka and Yuga Aoyama pass against Thirteen; Denki Kaminari and Mina Ashido fail against Nezu's demolition of their route; Kyoka Jiro and Koji Koda pass against Present Mic when Koji overcomes his fear and directs insects against him. Mezo Shoji and Toru Hagakure pass against Snipe by combining cover and invisibility to reach him. Hanta Sero falls asleep against Nemuri Kayama and fails, while Minoru Mineta uses Sero's tape and carries him out to pass. By canon default Izuku Midoriya and Katsuki Bakugo face All Might in Ground Beta's mock city, struggle to cooperate, then escape with Izuku carrying an unconscious Katsuki through the gate. Recovery Girl treats the injured. Unless the player changes the results, the five practical failures are Eijiro, Rikido, Denki, Mina and Hanta. Aizawa later reveals that they still attend camp, with extra lessons.

A Hero Course student party takes its assigned practical with a partner; its result follows the actual escape or capture. Class 1-B follows its own faculty assignments rather than replacing the listed 1-A pairs. Faculty parties test the students within the exercise's rules. Invited pros and sidekicks can observe from the monitor rooms. General Studies, Support and Management parties have approved observation or support duties, not automatic exam entry. Civilians and villains hear secondhand accounts outside U.A. Academy; they do not receive campus access from this event. Injured students receive care before returning to the staging hall.

The event is complete when every assigned practical has ended and each student's result is posted.

forest_camp_arrival.title: Arrival at the Forest Camp
forest_camp_arrival.beats:
Early morning at U.A. Academy: the buses for Class 1-A and Class 1-B leave the main campus loaded with gear, Shota Aizawa riding with 1-A and Vlad King with 1-B. Hours later the 1-A bus stops at a mountain overlook. Mandalay and Pixie-Bob of the Wild Wild Pussycats strike a pose and give the team cry, "Stingingly cute and catlike!", with Kota Izumi, a small child, scowling beside them. Mandalay points across the valley to the Wild Wild Pussycats Lodge and says the class can reach it on foot in three hours. Pixie-Bob's Earth Flow then sweeps the whole class off the edge into Beast's Forest. The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the forest is the Pussycats' private land, and Pixie-Bob's earth beasts hunt the class through it all day; the students fight and cooperate their way across and stagger into the lodge late in the afternoon, eight hours later, starving. At the lodge Ragdoll and Tiger serve dinner, Kota meets Izuku Midoriya with open contempt for anyone who wants to be a hero, and Mandalay quietly explains that his parents were heroes killed on duty. Aizawa announces that training starts at dawn.

A student party is dropped into Beast's Forest and chooses routes, partners and how to beat the earth beasts. A faculty party rides the buses and watches from the overlook. A pro party can be with the Pussycats at the lodge. A villain party can only scout from far off; the camp's location was kept quiet. Kota is a child and is always shown as one.

The event is complete when the classes reach the lodge and sit down to dinner.

forest_camp_raid.title: The Forest Camp Raid
forest_camp_raid.beats:
The third night of camp in Beast's Forest. Class 1-A walks the test-of-courage route while Class 1-B provides scares; remedial students stay with Shota Aizawa at the Wild Wild Pussycats Lodge. Smoke rises and blue fire spreads as the League of Villains' Vanguard Action Squad attacks.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Magne fells Pixie-Bob, then fights Mandalay and Tiger alongside Spinner; Dabi burns the woods, Mustard fills the paths with gas, and Twice sends doubles into the fighting. Mandalay broadcasts the alarm, Aizawa's permission for self-defense and the warning that Katsuki Bakugo is the target. Unless the player intervenes, Ragdoll is abducted and remains captive. At Kota's Secret Hideout, Izuku Midoriya reaches the child Kota Izumi before Muscular can kill him, defeats Muscular and badly injures both arms. Kota's rescue stays child-safe, without graphic harm to the child. By canon default Mezo Shoji struggles to contain Fumikage Tokoyami's frenzied Dark Shadow; it defeats Moonfish before Katsuki and Shoto Todoroki use light to restore control. Itsuka Kendo disperses gas around Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, who withstands Mustard's gunfire; together they defeat him and end the gas attack. Himiko Toga confronts Ochaco Uraraka and Tsuyu Asui and takes Ochaco's blood before withdrawing. Momo Yaoyorozu and Yosetsu Awase face a chainsaw-armed Nomu; Momo creates a tracker and Awase welds it onto the creature. Unless the player changes that escape, the tracker survives to make the Kamino operation possible. Mr. Compress captures both Katsuki and Fumikage in marbles. The students chase him; Yuga Aoyama's laser jars Compress, allowing Fumikage's recovery, but Dabi secures Katsuki's marble. By canon default Kurogiri opens the escape gate, the League leaves with Katsuki and Ragdoll, and police take Muscular, Moonfish and Mustard.

A Hero Course student party starts on its actual forest route or in the lodge; faculty and pros defend the lodge, rescue students and count the missing. Other U.A. courses remain outside the secret camp unless an established support assignment puts them there. Sidekicks and civilians can join emergency services on the mountain road once summoned. A villain party that took a place in the Vanguard Action Squad comes through Kurogiri's gate with the squad into Beast's Forest at dusk and works the assignment it was given at the briefing (the gas line, the lodge, the hunt for Katsuki); the order is Katsuki Bakugo alive, the escape gate opens at a set signal and waits for no one, and the Pussycats, Aizawa, Vlad King and the students fight back hard. A villain party fights with the Vanguard or waits with Tomura Shigaraki and Kurogiri at the League Hideout Bar for the extraction signal. Injured parties keep their wounds and receive evacuation rather than returning directly to class.

The event is complete when the attackers have escaped or been captured, the missing are identified, and the injured are being evacuated for treatment.

camp_aftermath.title: After the Camp
camp_aftermath.beats:
Day 128, mid morning at Musutafu General Hospital. By default Izuku Midoriya rests in Patient Rooms with his arms immobilized after the forest attack; visitors wait for permission rather than crowding his bed. Recovery Girl consults the doctors, and Inko Midoriya demands a clear account of his condition. At U.A. Academy, Principal Nezu, Shota Aizawa and Vlad King prepare a televised apology while families call for news of the missing.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the doctors explain that repeated catastrophic fractures have damaged Izuku's arms. Another injury of this severity could leave him unable to use them; healing the present breaks does not erase that risk. Recovery Girl insists that his training must change. Classmates can bring comfort, anger or practical help, but cannot pronounce him fit. Katsuki Bakugo and Ragdoll remain missing unless the camp's resolved outcomes say otherwise. At the press conference, Nezu accepts responsibility for the academy's failure to protect its students. Reporters demand to know whether Katsuki will become a villain. Aizawa rejects that assumption and defends his student's resolve; Vlad faces questions about the camp's defenses. Their public answers protect the search and the victims' privacy.

By Path and place: at Musutafu General Hospital, Class 1-A friends visit within medical limits; Class 1-B and other students can check on their own injured classmates or deliver messages. Faculty, Licensed Pro Hero and Licensed Sidekick parties coordinate care and witness statements. Civilian relatives ask questions and arrange contact; Support and Management students can help with approved practical tasks. At U.A. Academy's Lecture Hall, faculty face the cameras, Management students assist the press arrangements, and other courses watch from permitted spaces or Heights Alliance. Vigilantes and villain Paths encounter hospital security or the public broadcast, not confidential charts or an automatic rescue briefing. Existing injuries and altered captivity outcomes govern every visit; neither the conference nor an absent-player summary restores a kidnapping the party prevented.The event is complete when the medical warning has been delivered, the press conference has ended, and visits or family contacts have reached a stopping point.

kamino_incident.title: The Kamino Incident
kamino_incident.beats:
Night, days after the camp raid. Police under Naomasa Tsukauchi and selected pros prepare simultaneous raids on the League Hideout Bar and Nomu Warehouse in Kamino Ward. Katsuki Bakugo remains a captive who refuses recruitment unless the camp ended differently; the missing Ragdoll and the League remain targets either way. Momo Yaoyorozu and Yosetsu Awase's tracker supplies the warehouse lead.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: All Might breaks into the bar, Kamui Woods binds the League, Edgeshot knocks Kurogiri unconscious and Gran Torino blocks escape. At the warehouse, Best Jeanist, Mount Lady, Gang Orca and Tiger find dormant Nomu and Ragdoll. Shigaraki's masked Sensei appears and levels the warehouse block with a blast, gravely injuring Best Jeanist despite his attempt to protect the team. Unless the player changes the counterattack, the masked man forcibly transports the League and Katsuki to the warehouse ruins, and All Might arrives from the bar. The man identifies himself as All For One and meets All Might with combinations of stolen Quirks while helicopters broadcast the fighting.

By canon default Izuku Midoriya, Shoto Todoroki, Eijiro Kirishima, Tenya Iida and Momo, who planned a rescue at Musutafu General Hospital, use an ice ramp to launch Eijiro above the battle. Katsuki takes his hand and escapes with them. All For One then forces Kurogiri's Warp Gate to carry the League away through Kurogiri's unconscious body before the final duel; Kurogiri is not arrested. Unless the player changes the fight, All For One tells All Might that Tomura Shigaraki is Nana Shimura's grandson. That revelation stays with those who actually hear it, outside public knowledge. All Might's thin, wounded body becomes visible on television. With his remaining strength he defeats All For One using United States of Smash, then points at the camera and says, "Next, it's your turn." Police take All For One into custody. Ragdoll is recovered alive but without Search; Best Jeanist and the other wounded receive hospital care.

A student party at Musutafu General Hospital can join the rescue plan or alert faculty; other U.A. courses can supply an established support route without automatic entry into the raid. Faculty coordinate student safety; pros and sidekicks join either police operation. Villains start at the bar or their established post-camp position. Civilians evacuate Kamino's streets or watch from shelters and screens across Japan. Injuries remain in force, and the critically wounded stay reachable for rescue.

The event is complete when All For One is in custody or has escaped, Katsuki's rescue or continued captivity is established, and the wounded have been handed to medical teams.

symbol_of_peace_retires.title: The Symbol of Peace Retires
symbol_of_peace_retires.beats:
The week after Kamino. Screens in U.A. Academy's dorm lounges, hospital waiting rooms, agencies, shops and hideouts carry the debate over All Might's future. His announcement follows what the battle actually cost him; if the player preserved his ability to fight, the public response follows that changed result.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: All Might retires from hero work after spending his remaining power at Kamino and continues teaching at U.A. Academy. He can briefly flex into his muscle form, but cannot sustain hero work. Endeavor becomes the highest-ranked active hero without immediately replacing All Might's public role. All For One is transferred to Tartarus. Unless the player changes the response, petty crime and Stain-inspired copycats increase while Principal Nezu tightens campus security. Heights Alliance is already home to the students: this is a stricter lockdown, with curfews, approved sign-outs, new walls and sensors. Teachers visit families to explain the safeguards and seek their support.

By canon default Shota Aizawa and All Might visit homes such as the Jiro and Bakugo homes together. All Might visits the Midoriya home alone. Inko Midoriya challenges the repeated injuries to Izuku Midoriya and initially refuses to trust U.A. with him; All Might bows and promises to protect and teach him, while Izuku explains his determination. Unless the player changes their agreement, Inko gives her support under that promise. At a later private meeting on Dagobah Municipal Beach, All Might and Izuku confront what happened at Kamino; All Might promises to devote himself to raising Izuku as his successor. Their relationship to One For All remains private to those already entrusted with it. The public hears a retirement and a teaching commitment, not the secret of his power.

A student party faces curfew changes in Heights Alliance and its own family's response; General Studies, Support and Management students also live under the security rules. Faculty join family visits or arrange accommodations for injured students. Pros and sidekicks take additional calls and respond to the loss of deterrence. Civilians discuss safety at home, in shops and at work. Villains hear brokers such as Giran report fresh League interest; Tomura Shigaraki rebuilds from the League's current refuge without his imprisoned Sensei. Only an invited party joins the Midoriya home or Dagobah Beach scenes; others encounter their public consequences.

The event is complete when the retirement decision and campus restrictions are public and U.A. has recorded the families' responses to the visits.

provisional_license_exam.title: The Provisional License Exam
provisional_license_exam.beats:
Early morning at U.A. Academy's Main Gate. Class 1-A boards buses with Shota Aizawa for Takoba Municipal Stadium, costumes packed. Class 1-B takes the Hero Public Safety Commission's exam at another venue. In Takoba's Waiting Hall, Yokumiru Mera briefs 1,540 Hero Course examinees: the first 100 qualify for phase two. Each wears three targets and carries six balls; three target hits eliminate a wearer, and two eliminations qualify the thrower.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: other academies exploit U.A.'s televised Sports Festival techniques. Yo Shindo of Ketsubutsu fractures the Exam Arena beneath 1-A while Ms. Joke watches. Inasa Yoarashi eliminates dozens quickly; Seiji Shishikura turns Katsuki Bakugo and Eijiro Kirishima into helpless masses. Unless the player changes their encounter, Denki Kaminari uses his directed electricity to defeat Shishikura and free both classmates. Yuga Aoyama fires a conspicuous laser beacon, gathering scattered 1-A students so they can cooperate and clear phase one. By canon default the real Camie Utsushimi is absent: Himiko Toga impersonates her, approaches Izuku Midoriya and takes his blood before leaving. Her identity and the stolen blood stay with those who discover them, not the stadium's general audience.

Unless the player changes phase two, Help Us Company actors play casualties in the Rescue Exercise Ruins; examinees start with 100 points and need 50. Gang Orca and his sidekicks attack as mock villains. Shoto Todoroki and Inasa let their feud disrupt fire, wind and rescue work. They finally cooperate against Gang Orca, but too late to recover their scores. Katsuki's hostile treatment of casualties also costs him a pass. By canon default everyone in 1-A except Katsuki and Shoto receives a license; Inasa also fails. At the separate venue, all of 1-B passes. The real Camie's absence leaves her untested rather than a failed participant in this exam.

A Hero Course student party attends its assigned venue and keeps its actual injuries and eligibility. General Studies, Support and Management parties watch from permitted stands or volunteer in approved support roles. Faculty observe; pros and sidekicks examine, supervise or play mock villains. Civilians can work with Help Us Company. Villains operate outside security or through an established infiltration, without automatic entry. From U.A. Academy the opening can include departure and the ride; at either venue the party joins its proper stage rather than being moved into 1-A's roster.

The event is complete when both phases at the party's venue have ended, results are announced and the successful examinees receive their license cards, or officials formally cancel the exam.

deku_vs_kacchan_2.title: Deku vs. Kacchan, Part 2
deku_vs_kacchan_2.beats:
Day 170, night at U.A. Academy. After the provisional license results, Katsuki Bakugo calls Izuku Midoriya out of Heights Alliance and leads him to Ground Beta's Mock City Streets. He has pieced together a connection between Izuku's strength and All Might, but the question behind the challenge is why someone he judged weak received his idol's trust.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Katsuki demands a fight away from the dorms. His anger breaks into guilt over being kidnapped and setting in motion the battle that ended All Might's career. Izuku recognizes that winning and saving have always meant different things to them. Unless interrupted, they fight seriously without intending to kill: Izuku uses Shoot Style and briefly pushes Full Cowl to eight percent, while Katsuki adapts his blasts and wins the exchange. A party can separate them, talk Katsuki through the confession, summon staff or change the fight's result; the emotional conflict does not require the default winner.

Narrator only, private to established witnesses: All Might arrives and confirms One For All's transfer from himself to Izuku. He tells Katsuki that his retirement is not Katsuki's fault and asks him to keep the secret. Izuku already knows his own history; this is Katsuki's confirmation, not a public announcement or a class lesson. All Might urges them to learn each other's strengths. No nearby student learns the secret merely because an event runs.

By Path and place: a Class 1-A party at U.A. Academy can notice the departure, follow to Ground Beta or report the absence. Class 1-B, General Studies, Support and Management parties need an established reason to be outside after curfew; faculty can intervene directly. Licensed pros and sidekicks act through campus permission. Civilian, vigilante and villain Paths remain subject to security and gain no automatic access to the private talk. Back at U.A. Academy, Shota Aizawa hears the report and, by default, orders house arrest and dorm cleaning: four days for Katsuki, three for Izuku. Keep their absence from lessons and cleaning duties in the following days; do not lift the punishment at scene end or force it onto an innocent participant.

The event is complete when the confrontation has stopped, the private conversation or its changed alternative has resolved, and Aizawa has assigned the consequences.

league_meets_overhaul.title: The League Meets Overhaul
league_meets_overhaul.beats:
Day 178, early evening in Yokohama Harbor District's Dockside Safehouse. Giran brings Overhaul to the League's current refuge, not its ruined former bar. Tomura Shigaraki hears a proposal for combining forces; Magne and Mr. Compress wait close enough to react. Overhaul regards the League's notoriety as a resource and its leader as someone who should serve him.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the offer turns into contempt over authority, organization and the League's failures. Magne refuses to surrender her freedom and attacks. Unless the party prevents contact, Overhaul kills Magne with his Quirk; keep the danger interruptible before the fatal touch, with rescue or treatment available if she is wounded instead. Mr. Compress moves against him and loses his left arm to Overhaul's touch by default. Stop the immediate bleeding and get him to a hospital ward; injury never removes him from play as a death would. Shigaraki retaliates against Overhaul's accompanying men, and a standoff ends the clash before it consumes both groups.The meeting leaves the League furious rather than converted. In the default follow-up, Shigaraki accepts a temporary arrangement on his own terms and lends Himiko Toga and Twice to the Hassaikai. They resent Magne's loss and remain loyal to the League. Stage the negotiation and their subsequent arrival at Shie Hassaikai Compound's Main House only after the initial confrontation is settled; they do not begin already loaned out. A saved Magne or prevented mutilation changes the grievance and bargaining without making the alliance inevitable.

By Path and place: a League of Villains Recruit in Yokohama Harbor District can argue terms, protect a comrade or break the meeting apart. Independent Villain and broker contacts need a credible invitation. At Shie Hassaikai Compound, an established associate sees Overhaul depart and later receives his account and the loaned pair. Hero, sidekick and vigilante Paths need surveillance evidence or an actual intervention to enter either covert scene. Students and civilians see ordinary dock activity and guarded private property; nothing supplies the meeting as public knowledge. Giran values his exit over choosing a side.

The event is complete when the clash and casualty care have resolved and the proposed loan of Toga and Twice has been accepted, refused or replaced by the party's negotiated result.

eri_first_encounter.title: The Girl in the Alley
eri_first_encounter.beats:
Day 186, mid morning at Sir Nighteye Hero Agency. Mirio Togata and Izuku Midoriya leave the Agency Office for a supervised work-study patrol near Shie Hassaikai Compound. In a nearby alley, a small child runs into Izuku and clings to him. Eri is frightened, bandaged and struggling to ask for help when Overhaul appears to collect her.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Overhaul presents himself as a father dealing with a disobedient child. Izuku notices Eri's terror and will not treat that explanation as reassurance. Mirio keeps their cover and tries to prevent a premature confrontation that could expose the investigation. When the encounter moves out of casual view, Overhaul's hand and manner make the threat immediate. Eri believes others will be hurt if she stays with them and returns to him. By default Mirio judges that they must let her go, and Izuku obeys despite his own impulse to carry her away. Both return troubled by what they have allowed; neither regards this as a successful rescue.

Give a party real room to change that choice: maintain contact, signal a supervising hero, obtain corroborating evidence, shield Eri or attempt a lawful rescue with the danger that actually follows. Eri is a child, never an interrogation tool, combatant or source of a convenient power demonstration. A successful rescue remains successful; no later beat quietly sends her back. If she returns, Overhaul takes her into the Restricted Wing and increases his control, without graphic treatment or an invented public disclosure.

By Path and place: at Sir Nighteye Hero Agency, work-study students receive a route into the patrol; licensed pros and sidekicks can supervise, respond or debrief it. Class 1-B can participate through an established placement, while General Studies, Support and Management students require an approved role rather than automatic patrol authority. At Shie Hassaikai Compound, an established villain associate can see the return and choose whether to help conceal or challenge it; an outsider encounters guarded entrances. Civilian and vigilante Paths can witness the alley exchange, offer help or call responders. League recruits have only their actual access through Toga and Twice's loan, not automatic knowledge of Eri or every room.

The event is complete when Eri's immediate custody and safety have been resolved and the patrol has reported the encounter to its supervising agency.

case_conference.title: The Case Conference
case_conference.beats:
Day 203, mid morning in Sir Nighteye Hero Agency's Meeting Room. Sir Nighteye gathers the agencies working the Hassaikai case, their work-study students and police investigators. Fat Gum, Ryukyu, Rock Lock and Shota Aizawa sit with the students who may join the operation. The invitation is a confidential summons, with time and transport to reach the agency, not an unexplained relocation into a sealed meeting.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Fat Gum describes the bullet recovered after Tamaki Amajiki was shot during patrol. The temporary suppression of his Quirk and the biological material found in the ammunition connect street dealing to something more deliberate. Nighteye links the evidence to Eri and Overhaul. Keep the explanation clinical and child-safe: the investigators believe a child is being exploited to develop ammunition that can damage Quirks. Izuku Midoriya and Mirio Togata face the fact that they encountered her and let her go. Rock Lock challenges the decision to involve students in a dangerous operation; their resolve matters, but licensed command remains responsible for their safety.

Nighteye presents the search and surveillance work. Foresight used on a Hassaikai associate confirms the route to Eri's confinement; he does not predict from a photograph or scan every possible future. If the confirmation is still pending in the live story, play the team's wait and report before final orders. By default the assembled agencies set the raid for day 205 and divide entry, arrest and rescue duties. A party can question the evidence, offer a stronger lead, arrange protections or change the plan; a prior rescue changes the objective to remaining victims and criminal evidence instead of manufacturing another captive Eri.

By Path and place: at Sir Nighteye Hero Agency, licensed work-study students from either Hero Course attend with their supervisors. Faculty, Licensed Pro Hero and Licensed Sidekick parties can evaluate roles, risks and coordination. General Studies, Support and Management parties contribute only through an established approved assignment, with access limited to need. Civilian witnesses give statements separately. Vigilantes may supply a lead without being admitted to the operation; League recruits, Independent Villains and other outsiders need an actual breach or informant to learn the plan. Information stays inside the briefing, and injured participants retain their limitations.

The event is complete when the evidence and Eri's status have been reviewed and the team has agreed on a raid plan or a concrete changed course.

shie_hassaikai_raid.title: The Shie Hassaikai Raid
shie_hassaikai_raid.beats:
Dawn at the Sir Nighteye Hero Agency. Sir Nighteye, Mirio Togata, Izuku Midoriya, Bubble Girl and Centipeder prepare to raid Kai Chisaki, called Overhaul, at the Shie Hassaikai Compound. Their case links his Quirk-destroying bullets to the exploitation of Eri, a child held inside. Fat Gum brings Tamaki Amajiki and Eijiro Kirishima; Ryukyu brings Nejire Hado, Ochaco Uraraka and Tsuyu Asui. Shota Aizawa, Rock Lock and police join the staging. Work-study students receive their summons through their agencies and deploy under their pros.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: police serve the warrant, Rikiya Katsukame attacks outside and Ryukyu's team holds him while the entry team advances. Mimic reshapes the Underground Passages to split the heroes. Unless the player changes the encounters, Tamaki defeats Yu Hojo, Soramitsu Tabe and Toya Setsuno; Fat Gum and Eijiro overcome Kendo Rappa and Hekiji Tengai. Other enforcers, including Deidoro Sakaki and Shin Nemoto, delay the pursuit. Himiko Toga and Twice are inside on loan from the League of Villains. They sabotage their hosts, attack and misdirect the heroes, then goad Mimic into exposing himself through his anger; they escape rather than remain loyal to Overhaul.

By canon default Mirio reaches Eri ahead of the team, fights Overhaul and Chronostasis, and protects her when a Quirk-destroying bullet is fired at her. The bullet takes Mirio's Permeation, but he continues defending her. Overhaul gravely wounds Nighteye. Unless the player changes the rescue, Eri reaches Izuku; her Rewind reverses the damage from his power, letting him sustain 100% One For All and defeat Overhaul above ground. The power's name and inheritance remain private, not a public explanation. Eri's Rewind then runs out of control until Aizawa erases it. She receives protective medical care and is never treated as a weapon. Nighteye remains reachable for rescue and treatment; his death from the wound afterward is the canon default unless changed care or fighting saves him.

A participating student party answers its agency summons; other U.A. courses assist only through established support duties or remain at U.A. Academy. Faculty, pros and sidekicks enter with the operation or maintain the street perimeter. A Fat Gum party can begin with the call from Osaka Downtown. Villains inside the compound face shifting halls and orders to hold the heroes back; League parties can act with Toga and Twice. Civilians meet police tape and evacuation routes outside the compound.

The event is complete when Eri is in protective medical care with Rewind contained, Overhaul is captured or has escaped, and the wounded have been transferred to medical teams.

convoy_ambush.title: The Convoy Ambush
convoy_ambush.beats:
Day 205, early evening after the Hassaikai raid. At Shie Hassaikai Compound, police prepare Overhaul and the seized evidence for guarded transport.The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Tomura Shigaraki and Mr. Compress strike the convoy with Dabi. Snatch shields officers and challenges the attackers. Dabi's flames and Compress's attempt to confine him place him in mortal danger; by default he is killed unless a party's protection, extraction or treatment saves him. Keep a rescue opening before his death is established. Mr. Compress seizes the remaining Quirk-destroying bullets and their serum.Do not treat either captive as dead. Emergency care and guarded hospital wards follow the mutilations, and a party can prevent or limit them by defending the prisoners or stopping the attackers.

Overhaul must actually have been captured in the raid for his transfer to occur. Respect a changed raid result: if he escaped or the ammunition was secured elsewhere, the League must pursue a real surviving target or abandon the attack. Evidence stolen here is no longer available to police in the next scene. The ambush seeks revenge and valuable material, not a replay of the compound battle, and it does not settle Sir Nighteye's medical outcome.

By Path and place: a pro or sidekick party at Shie Hassaikai Compound can escort, guard evidence or remain with casualties; licensed work-study students act under orders and may be kept away from transport. Other students and civilians encounter a cordon, traffic disruption or later reports. In Yokohama Harbor District, a League recruit can join a credible rendezvous at Container Docks or receive the returning attackers in Dockside Safehouse. Independent Villains and vigilantes can intervene through an actual sighting, not an unexplained tip about the route. Give defenders choices between escort protection, Snatch's rescue, pursuit and evidence recovery. Criminal plans and the bullets' capabilities remain restricted to witnesses.

The event is complete when the convoy attack or its prevented alternative has ended, surviving casualties are in care, and custody of the prisoners, bullets and serum is established.

nighteye_farewell.title: Sir Nighteye's Farewell
nighteye_farewell.beats:
Day 206, mid morning at Musutafu General Hospital. Sir Nighteye remains in Patient Rooms after emergency treatment for the raid's critical injuries. Mirio Togata, Izuku Midoriya, Bubble Girl and Centipeder wait for the doctors' permission to visit. All Might comes to the bedside. Eri receives protective pediatric care elsewhere in the hospital, with access controlled by staff; she is not brought in to repair an adult's body.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: if Nighteye suffered the raid's grave wounds and no successful intervention has changed his prognosis, the doctors cannot save him. His final hours remain playable before death is resolved. All Might and his former sidekick reconcile after years of disagreement. Nighteye acknowledges that the outcome he foresaw was changed and begins to believe that human effort can alter a future he had treated as fixed. Narrator only, private to the bedside's established confidants: any discussion of All Might's predicted fate or Izuku's inherited power stays within its existing knowledge boundaries. Visitors do not acquire One For All merely by hearing a farewell.

Mirio reaches his mentor despite his own loss. By default Nighteye uses Foresight on him and offers hope for the hero he can become, asking him to keep smiling. Nighteye dies only as the preventable canon default, after farewells and any real chance of care have resolved. If the raid already spared him, or credible treatment here stabilizes him, replace the deathbed ending with a difficult recovery and the same honest reconciliation. No miraculous cure is granted merely for asking, and Recovery Girl's stamina limits still apply if help is sought. Survival does not restore Mirio's Quirk.

By Path and place: at Musutafu General Hospital, work-study companions and approved visitors can support Mirio, arrange a final visit or help doctors obtain actual resources. Faculty, Licensed Pro Hero and Licensed Sidekick parties coordinate care and protect privacy; students from other courses have the access their relationships justify. Civilian relatives and staff can comfort, relay messages or work within their qualifications. Vigilante and villain Paths encounter hospital security unless an established relationship or infiltration gives access. Eri remains a protected child and is never pressed to witness death or use Rewind.

The event is complete when the farewells have resolved and Nighteye's death or medically established survival has been recorded, with Eri's protective care continuing.

kurogiri_captured.title: Kurogiri Captured
kurogiri_captured.beats:
Day 209, mid morning at Musutafu Police Headquarters. Naomasa Tsukauchi coordinates the search for the League's warp villain from the Detectives' Office. Gran Torino prepares to pursue the trail, with Gran Torino's Apartment serving as a quiet place to compare leads and arrange departure. Kurogiri escaped Kamino; today's investigation must not presume an earlier capture there.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the investigators track Kurogiri into remote mountains after the Hassaikai operation.A party that joins through the briefing travels with the operation, while one that stays behind handles communications or waits for its report. Gran Torino closes on Kurogiri and the police secure him before he can open a successful escape. A colossal figure, Gigantomachia, is glimpsed during the pursuit; the team survives the threat and brings Kurogiri out. The giant is not captured, defeated or publicly identified by this scene, and witnessing his presence supplies no explanation of his origin.

Once restrained, Kurogiri undergoes guarded processing and transfer to Tartarus's Maximum-Security Cell Block by default.A party can change the approach, protect officers, interrupt a warp escape or help Kurogiri evade custody. If he escapes, record the escape and the continuing search instead of applying the default cell placement. His body and collar can be restrained; his gate does not provide an automatic exit after unconsciousness or effective containment.

By Path and place: at Musutafu Police Headquarters, Licensed Pro Hero and Licensed Sidekick parties can join an authorized operation; faculty advise through existing contacts. At Gran Torino's Apartment, invited students or associates may hear a limited briefing, but students need permission and a lawful role before entering the field. General Studies, Support and Management Paths offer approved logistical help. Civilians give statements or later hear the arrest announcement. A League recruit or Independent Villain needs an established warning or contact to reach Kurogiri; a vigilante can follow actual evidence and faces the operation's cordon. The prison transfer exposes no information about Kurogiri's human identity, which remains unknown to the investigators here.

The event is complete when the mountain pursuit has ended and Kurogiri's secure custody and transfer, or his escape, has been established.

license_remedial_course.title: The License Remedial Course
license_remedial_course.beats:
A mid-course lesson at Takoba Municipal Stadium during the Commission's remedial program. Katsuki Bakugo, Shoto Todoroki, Inasa Yoarashi and Camie Utsushimi work under instructors including Gang Orca. Camie attends because Himiko Toga's impersonation left the real Camie untested. Today's assignment is to win the trust of children from Masegaki Primary School; the final licensing assessment comes later, after Joint Training.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the children mock the candidates, ignore instructions and show off their Quirks. Katsuki wants to impose order, Shoto's formal approach fails to connect and Inasa's enthusiasm does not win them over. The instructors demand that the candidates understand the children rather than overpower them. Unless the player finds another safe approach, the candidates abandon lecturing and combine their abilities into a supervised attraction: Shoto shapes an ice slide, Inasa guides wind, Camie provides Glamour illusions and Katsuki uses controlled blasts to help build the show. The children are always written child-safe; nobody injures, humiliates or threatens them. By canon default they join the fun and accept the candidates. Katsuki speaks with their leader about how looking down on others hides one's own weaknesses, showing a change in how he treats people.

Unless the player changes the observers' conversation, Endeavor watches Shoto from the stands and asks All Might what it means to be a Symbol. All Might discusses the responsibility and the need for Endeavor to find his own answer; Endeavor's encouragement embarrasses Shoto. The day ends with feedback on the candidates' ability to reach the children. No candidate receives a license at this lesson; Katsuki, Shoto and Inasa remain unlicensed, and Camie still has her assessment ahead.

A remedial student party takes the lesson; licensed students and other U.A. courses can observe or assist with an approved volunteer role. Faculty, pros and sidekicks supervise the activity and its safety. Civilians are parents, school staff or stadium workers. A villain or vigilante outside Takoba has no automatic access to the children or training floor. At the Hero Public Safety Commission Headquarters, Yokumiru Mera and Licensing Bureau staff handle progress reports and future assessment arrangements; they do not sign licenses today. An injured party receives an appropriate observation or assistance role rather than being treated as recovered.

The event is complete when the children give their verdict for the day and the instructors close the lesson with feedback.

school_festival.title: The U.A. School Festival
school_festival.beats:
Festival morning at U.A. Academy. Screened guests enter through the Main Gate, police watch the perimeter and a security alarm will cancel the day. Stalls, cafes, haunted houses and Support Course exhibits fill campus; Mei Hatsume pitches her equipment. U.A. Stadium hosts Class 1-A's show and the beauty pageant. If the Hassaikai rescue succeeded, Eri attends safely with Mirio Togata; she remains a child throughout.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: before the show, Izuku Midoriya goes off campus for rope and encounters Gentle Criminal and La Brava on the wooded hill outside the barrier. Gentle once wanted to become a hero, but repeated failures and a failed rescue led him toward filmed crimes and a wish to be remembered. La Brava found purpose in his videos and became his devoted partner. Unless the player changes the encounter, their planned festival intrusion forces Izuku to fight on the wooded hill and the construction approach outside campus, keeping the threat away from the Main Gate and its alarm. Gentle uses Elasticity on the surroundings; Izuku answers with Air Force, directing compressed-air finger flicks through Hatsume's gloves. La Brava declares her love and activates Love to strengthen Gentle. By canon default Izuku defeats the boosted Gentle, and Gentle surrenders quietly while trying to shield La Brava from blame. Hound Dog and the security response take the pair in without triggering the campus alarm; their intrusion video never airs.

Unless the player changes the festival's course, Izuku returns in time for Class 1-A's band and dance set. Kyoka Jiro leads vocals and bass, Katsuki Bakugo plays drums, Mina Ashido leads the dancing, Shoto Todoroki supplies ice effects and Ochaco Uraraka supplies Zero Gravity effects. The show wins over students frustrated by the Hero Course's security restrictions. Eri smiles during the performance by canon default, and Izuku later brings her a candy apple. Nejire Hado wins the beauty pageant. Any actual security emergency can still stop the festival.

A student party performs, runs a stall or visits other courses' attractions; Support students demonstrate equipment and Management students help organize the day. Faculty run campus security, and pros and sidekicks serve as guards or invited guests. Villains can join Gentle's off-campus attempt or pursue an established infiltration. Civilians attend as screened guests. A party on the wooded hill can intervene directly; one at U.A. Stadium sees the show without automatically learning about the quiet arrest.

The event is complete when Class 1-A's show and the festival have ended, or officials announce a cancellation and clear the guests from campus.

billboard_chart.title: The Hero Billboard Chart
billboard_chart.beats:
Evening at the Hero Billboard Chart Hall. The Commission President presents the first Hero Billboard Chart JP since All Might's retirement. The Tokyo Broadcasting Center carries the live ceremony while crowds gather at screens over Central Tokyo Streets. Ranked heroes face cameras on the Stage, reporters crowd the Press Gallery and the vacant Symbol of Peace role hangs over every introduction.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the ranks are announced from tenth upward. Number Ten is Ryukyu; Nine, Yoroi Musha; Eight, Wash; Seven, Kamui Woods; Six, Crust; Five, Mirko; Four, Edgeshot; Three, Best Jeanist; Two, Hawks; One, Endeavor. Wash and Mirko are present with the other attending ranked heroes. Best Jeanist is absent, still recovering from Kamino unless the player's changed story spared him. These are the default rankings rather than a restriction on changes the player has already earned.

Unless the player changes the exchanges, the heroes give their remarks and Hawks breaks the ceremony's stiff mood with a casual challenge to the room. He needles the senior heroes over public approval and their inability to reassure the country, then turns attention toward Endeavor. The new Number One faces an audience that doubts he can fill All Might's place. By canon default Endeavor gives a short answer asking the country to watch him, rather than promising to imitate his predecessor. The broadcast ends with an unsettled public weighing his words. The ceremony establishes the new order, not proof that the country's confidence has recovered.

A ranked pro party can speak on the Stage; other pros and sidekicks attend through invitations or agency work and can respond to the reporters afterward. Faculty and students from every U.A. course watch in Heights Alliance or on an approved outing. A Management party can study the broadcast and agency response; Support students can follow the equipment and presentation without gaining stage access. At the Tokyo Broadcasting Center, Uwabami waits for her booked studio segment while staff decide which shots air. Civilians and villain parties on Central Tokyo Streets hear the crowd's response around the big screens; reporters work the Press Gallery with credentials. A party that speaks can change the room's mood and the ensuing coverage through what it actually says.

The event is complete when the chart announcements and closing remarks have finished and the live ceremony broadcast ends.

high_end_attack.title: The High-End in Fukuoka
high_end_attack.beats:
Daytime in Fukuoka, after the Billboard Chart. Hawks hosts Endeavor for a discussion of teamwork and reports of unusual Nomu. Their meeting near the Hawks Hero Agency takes them through Fukuoka Downtown and into a restaurant. Hood, a speaking High-End Nomu, attacks, forcing the new Number One into a public battle before he has earned the country's trust.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Endeavor takes Hood above the streets while Hawks spreads his feathers to rescue civilians from the collapsing building and surrounding danger. Hood flies, regenerates and reshapes his arms into weapons; smaller Nomu released from his body add to the evacuation pressure. Unless the player changes the fight, Hood badly wounds Endeavor across the face and throws him down while news helicopters broadcast the scene. Hood escapes an attempted incineration by separating his head and regenerating, forcing Endeavor to push beyond his first attack. Hawks spends feathers on rescues and then lends Endeavor the speed he needs to carry Hood high above the city. By canon default Endeavor destroys Hood with his final Plus Ultra Prominence Burn and raises his fist for the cameras. His victory leaves him exhausted and badly injured rather than ready for another full fight.

Unless the player changes the aftermath, Dabi confronts Endeavor and Hawks in person, surrounding the exhausted heroes with a fresh threat. Mirko arrives before he can press the attack. Dabi retreats instead of being captured, and the heroes turn to treatment and the remaining evacuation. Any covert dealings involving Hawks stay with those who actually know them; the public sees his rescue work and assistance to Endeavor, not a secret assignment.

At Hakata Station, halted trains and crowded concourses give a civilian or student party a direct evacuation scene while screens carry the fight. A supervised work-study student helps under a pro; other U.A. courses can assist through an established placement or watch from Heights Alliance. Faculty coordinate student safety from U.A. Academy. Pros and sidekicks fight smaller Nomu, move civilians and answer calls from the Hawks Hero Agency. A villain party can witness the test of Hood or join Dabi through an established connection. Wounded characters remain available to rescuers and go to medical care before agency or classroom returns.

The event is complete when Hood is destroyed or has escaped, Dabi has withdrawn or been contained, and the wounded heroes and endangered civilians are in emergency care.

deika_liberation.title: The Battle of Deika
deika_liberation.beats:
The League's current post-Kamino refuge, before the trip to Deika City. Rikiya Yotsubashi, called Re-Destro, uses the captured broker Giran to demand a confrontation with the Meta Liberation Army. Deika's Detnerat offices, City Hall Plaza and newsroom conceal an armed population. Tomura Shigaraki plans to draw Gigantomachia into the battle rather than fight the entire city unaided.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Shigaraki, Dabi, Himiko Toga, Twice, Spinner and Mr. Compress enter Deika and are attacked by its hidden soldiers. Chitose Kizuki, called Curious, surrounds Toga with followers and explosive traps while probing her past. Unless the player changes their fight, Toga's Quirk awakens: after taking Ochaco Uraraka's appearance, she can use Zero Gravity. She floats Curious and her followers, then releases them; Curious dies by canon default and Toga is left gravely wounded. Tomoyasu Chikazoku, called Skeptic, sends puppets to exploit Twice's fear of being a double. Injuries prove to Twice that he is the original, breaking his restraint; by canon default he unleashes Sad Man's Parade and his doubles rescue Toga and overwhelm attackers. Koku Hanabata, called Trumpet, rallies soldiers against Spinner and the League's advance. Dabi and Geten fight fire against ice without a decisive winner.

Unless the player changes the central battle, Shigaraki confronts Re-Destro, whose Stress and support equipment increase his strength. Shigaraki recovers memories of his life as Tenko Shimura and his family's destruction; these are his private memories, not public revelations. His spreading Decay destroys a large part of Deika. Re-Destro sacrifices his lower legs to escape it, recognizes Shigaraki as embodying liberation and surrenders. By canon default Gigantomachia witnesses Shigaraki's victory and kneels to acknowledge him. Giran survives, and the League and army subsequently unite as the Paranormal Liberation Front under Shigaraki. Skeptic edits footage to conceal the real struggle.

A villain party can travel from the League's actual refuge, fight for the League or defend the army's Deika positions. A pro, sidekick, faculty member, student or vigilante already in Deika is an unwarned visitor facing survival and evacuation, not a summoned raid participant. Civilians can be residents, visitors or concealed army members. Other U.A. courses have no automatic deployment; those outside Deika receive the public account afterward. The injured, including Toga and Re-Destro, remain available for aid before any later gathering.

The event is complete when the fighting has ended and the surviving factions have acknowledged Shigaraki's command or completed a changed surrender or withdrawal.

joint_training.title: The Joint Training Battle
joint_training.beats:
Morning at U.A. Academy. Class 1-A and Class 1-B walk to Training Ground Gamma's pipes and factory floors. At the Control Tower, Shota Aizawa and Vlad King set five capture rounds, twenty minutes each, with prisoners put in team jails. Hitoshi Shinso of General Studies wears Aizawa's capture scarf and uses his voice changer in a Hero Course transfer trial; All Might observes.

Canon default pressure: these teams and results stand unless the player changes them. Round one: Koji Koda, Denki Kaminari, Tsuyu Asui and Eijiro Kirishima, plus Shinso, face Jurota Shishida, Hiryu Rin, Kosei Tsuburaba and Ibara Shiozaki. Kaminari draws the enemy in, Shinso exploits their voices, and 1-A wins. Round two: Yuga Aoyama, Momo Yaoyorozu, Toru Hagakure and Fumikage Tokoyami face Itsuka Kendo, Manga Fukidashi, Kinoko Komori and Shihai Kuroiro. Tokoyami flies with Dark Shadow; Kendo counters Momo's planning and Komori's mushrooms stop Tokoyami, giving 1-B a 4-0 win. Round three: Tenya Iida, Shoto Todoroki, Mashirao Ojiro and Mezo Shoji face Juzo Honenuki, Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, Pony Tsunotori and Sen Kaibara. Tenya uses Recipro Turbo, Shoto's heat meets Tetsutetsu's endurance, and Honenuki's softening helps force a draw. Round four: Katsuki Bakugo, Hanta Sero, Kyoka Jiro and Rikido Sato face Togaru Kamakiri, Setsuna Tokage, Kojiro Bondo and Yosetsu Awase. Katsuki protects his teammates and accepts their help, producing a 4-0 win for 1-A.

By canon default round five pits Izuku Midoriya, Minoru Mineta, Mina Ashido and Ochaco Uraraka against Reiko Yanagi, Nirengeki Shoda, Neito Monoma and Yui Kodai, plus Shinso. Monoma's provocation precedes Blackwhip erupting out of Izuku's control; Ochaco reaches him and asks Shinso to use Brainwashing to stop it. Only Izuku experiences Daigoro Banjo's voice explaining the new power; One For All stays secret. Unless the player changes the recovery and resumed fight, Izuku briefly controls Blackwhip, 1-A wins the round and takes the exercise three wins to one with one draw. The teachers approve Shinso for a Hero Course transfer next year.

A Hero Course student fights or watches from Gamma's monitors; General Studies, Support and Management parties observe with permission, with Shinso's trial the stated exception. Faculty referee from the Control Tower; invited pros and sidekicks observe. Villains and civilians outside U.A. Academy hear only later campus accounts and have no automatic access.

The event is complete when round five ends, the overall result is announced and the teachers give their verdict on Shinso.

licenses_cider_house.title: The Final Assessment
licenses_cider_house.beats:
Day 253, Sunday mid morning at Takoba Municipal Stadium. Katsuki Bakugo, Shoto Todoroki, Inasa Yoarashi and the real Camie Utsushimi assemble for the remedial program's final assessment. The earlier lesson with Masegaki's children was practice, not the licensing decision. All Might accompanies U.A.'s pair as a retired teacher; he cannot return to combat.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: instructors assess the candidates' accumulated work and readiness, with rescue judgment and cooperation as well as control of their Quirks. Keep any played exercise supervised and nonlethal, without inventing a compulsory second battle with the children. By default all four pass and receive provisional hero licenses. Their authority begins with this successful result, not retroactively at the earlier lesson. A party can help them prepare, change an assessment performance or challenge an unsafe instruction; any changed result must follow what the assessors actually observe.

Within the hour, Katsuki and Shoto encounter the Cider House gang committing a support-item theft on the way back to U.A. Academy.The thieves use stolen equipment to threaten people and escape. Newly licensed, Katsuki and Shoto coordinate to stop them, protect bystanders and recover the gear. The player can take part, choose rescue over pursuit or change who secures the arrest.His arrival does not erase the students' work or disclose any hidden allegiance.

By Path and place: at Takoba Municipal Stadium, a remedial Hero Course student takes the assessment; licensed students and other courses observe or assist only with authorization. Faculty, pros and sidekicks supervise or accompany candidates. At U.A. Academy, classmates can see the departure or receive the returning pair and their cards, joining the street incident only through an established route. Civilian and vigilante Paths may witness the theft, call help or assist people at risk. Villain Paths need a real connection to the theft or its location, not access to the exam. Support students can identify recovered equipment through official follow-up; Management students can help with approved reporting. Preserve existing injuries and any earlier story-earned license.

The event is complete when the candidates' results are settled and the Cider House theft has been stopped, escaped or otherwise resolved.

garaki_procedure.title: The Doctor's Procedure
garaki_procedure.beats:
Day 258, early evening at Yokohama Harbor District's Dockside Safehouse. Tomura Shigaraki prepares to leave the Paranormal Liberation Front's ordinary business to its officers. At Jaku General Hospital, Kyudai Garaki maintains a kindly public medical routine while the concealed Basement Service Levels are prepared for a very different patient. The journey between the refuge and hospital remains covert.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: after winning the giant's loyalty and the liberation forces' resources, Shigaraki accepts Garaki's proposed four-month procedure. Narrator only, restricted to Garaki, Shigaraki and genuinely admitted confidants: the treatment is intended to strengthen Shigaraki's body and transfer All For One's power into him. It is not an instant upgrade or an ability he can use tonight. Garaki explains the duration and danger to his patient, then begins the procedure in the hidden hospital facility. By default Shigaraki remains there, incapacitated for ordinary League activity, while the Front continues to organize without his daily presence.

A party can question the bargain, expose the facility, delay the start, protect the patient or disrupt treatment through actions it can actually reach. Interruption produces the medical and organizational consequences established in play, not an automatic healthy Shigaraki with the completed power. The procedure's progress must carry into later months; this scene never advances four months or stages the coming war. Preserve a changed Deika result or an existing capture rather than manufacturing resources or a free patient.

By Path and place: a League of Villains Recruit in Yokohama Harbor District can receive limited orders, guard transport or notice the leader's absence. Independent Villains need Garaki's or the Front's actual trust to enter deeper business. At Jaku General Hospital, civilian patients and ordinary staff see wards and routine services; students, faculty, pros and sidekicks visiting publicly receive the same surface account. Support and Management Paths may examine legitimate equipment or records only within their assigned access. Heroes and vigilantes need evidence and a real route into the restricted basement to discover the operation. Being present in the hospital does not confer the doctor's identity as a villain, the hidden procedure's purpose or the source of Shigaraki's intended power. Keep uninvolved patients safe if the party intervenes.

The event is complete when Shigaraki has entered continuing treatment in the concealed facility, or the party's intervention has established a definite alternative and its immediate medical consequences.

ending_natsuo.title: The Ending
ending_natsuo.beats:
Day 265, early evening at Todoroki Estate, after the family's recent dinner. Natsuo Todoroki leaves the Main House still angry with Endeavor. Izuku Midoriya, Katsuki Bakugo and Shoto Todoroki continue their work-study with Endeavor Hero Agency.The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Ending seizes Natsuo on the road and holds him in the path of moving traffic. He demands a fatal response from Endeavor, treating a hostage as a means to his own death. Endeavor hesitates when his son's safety makes the cost of a mistake immediate. The three interns act using the skills he has made them practice: faster recognition, movement and decisive parallel work. By default Katsuki reaches and extracts Natsuo, Izuku uses Blackwhip to catch endangered vehicles and protect their occupants, and Shoto stops Ending. Give each role its actual constraints and let the party change the distribution of rescue and capture. Ending can be restrained alive; neither his demand nor the default scene requires anyone to kill him.

Afterward Endeavor reaches for Natsuo, but a rescue does not settle years of abuse. Natsuo need not forgive him, thank him or allow an embrace. Endeavor acknowledges that distance may be what his family needs and decides to arrange a separate home for them while he remains apart and works to atone.Fuyumi Todoroki hears what happened; her hope does not overrule her brother's boundaries.

By Path and place: at Todoroki Estate, invited guests or relatives can notice the departure, call help and follow a credible alarm onto the road. At Endeavor Hero Agency, a pro, sidekick or authorized work-study party receives the emergency and can join the response from Operations Floor. Other Hero Course students need permission and a real placement; General Studies, Support and Management Paths can assist communications or later equipment review within an approved role. Civilian and vigilante Paths may witness the hostage danger and prioritize people in traffic. Villain Paths need an actual connection or sighting; Ending's plan is not common criminal knowledge.The event is complete when Natsuo and the endangered road users are safe or in care, Ending's custody or escape is settled, and the family has had space to answer Endeavor's decision.

kurogiri_is_oboro.title: Oboro
kurogiri_is_oboro.beats:
Day 300, mid morning in Tartarus's Visitor Interview Room. Shota Aizawa and Present Mic meet Kurogiri under prison supervision, with Naomasa Tsukauchi coordinating the interview.The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: investigators explain privately that Kurogiri was created using the body of Oboro Shirakumo, Aizawa and Present Mic's friend who died during their academy years. Narrator only, restricted to this authorized interview and its evidence: this revelation concerns Kurogiri's origin and the human material used to make him. It is not a public unmasking.Aizawa speaks about the teacher he became and the students he tries to protect. Present Mic drops his broadcast voice and addresses their lost friend directly. Kurogiri initially answers in the terms of his duty to Tomura Shigaraki. By default their appeals reach a brief remnant: a distorted flicker of Oboro answers and produces a clue pointing toward a hospital before Kurogiri's usual state reasserts itself. Treat it as a fragment to investigate, not a complete recovery, a new ally or a full explanation of Jaku General Hospital. Tsukauchi records the response and joins it to other leads; confirmation and operational decisions still require investigation.

By Path and place: at Tartarus, faculty parties attend only with a legitimate invitation, not because they work at U.A. Licensed Pro Hero and Licensed Sidekick parties can provide authorized security or investigative support without taking over the friends' appeal. Hero Course students, General Studies, Support and Management parties receive no automatic prison access; an established specialist assignment can justify a limited role. Civilian relatives or witnesses require approval. A vigilante, League recruit or Independent Villain needs an actual infiltration or negotiated access and faces the prison's security; watching a news report does not reveal the meeting. The player can support the appeal, ask a careful question, notice the fragment or change the interview's course, while guards maintain containment and protect everyone present.

The event is complete when the interview has ended, any recovered clue is recorded for investigators, and Kurogiri has returned to secure custody or the changed custody outcome is established.

war_dawn.title: The Dawn Raids
war_dawn.beats:
Day 363, Friday, March 28, before dawn at spring break's end: teams enter Gunga Mountain Villa and Jaku General Hospital together. Jaku City evacuation orders begin; Hero Public Safety Commission Headquarters coordinates deployments. Start from the party's established assignment, location and injuries.
The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Endeavor, Shota Aizawa, Gran Torino, Crust, Ryukyu, Present Mic, Manual and Rock Lock enter the hospital. The Kyudai Garaki in public view is a double; the real doctor works below. Mirko breaks into the Basement Service Levels, fights the awakened High-Ends and drives toward Tomura Shigaraki's pod. Her left forearm is crushed and torn away and her right leg is badly wounded by default; keep her reachable for rescue and stabilization. Present Mic reaches and restrains the real Kyudai Garaki. The procedure is only 75 percent complete when the pod breaks; stop at the rupture, before Shigaraki wakes or Decay spreads.
At Gunga Mountain Villa, Cementoss opens the structure, Edgeshot leads the assault, and Nemuri Kayama, Mount Lady and Kamui Woods cover the advance. Denki Kaminari intercepts the opening electrical attack, giving the heroes an opening. The Front resists inside the Villa Great Hall; Gigantomachia remains on the Mountain Slopes. Hawks and Twice are inside, but their confrontation belongs to the next link.
At Headquarters' President's Office, a Rikiya Yotsubashi double turns a Detnerat meeting into an attack. The Commission President's death is the canon default unless someone protects her; keep her reachable until her fate is established. This is a double, not the original leaving Gunga.
By Path: licensed Class 1-A and Class 1-B Hero Course students evacuate Jaku City's Residential Hills or hold Gunga Mountain Villa's Mountain Slopes under their pros. Faculty, Licensed Pro Heroes and Licensed Sidekicks take their assigned front; Ectoplasm's clones support the hospital clearance. League of Villains Recruits defend the villa. Independent Villains and Vigilantes act in Jaku or the mountains only if already there. Civilians leave Jaku or await assisted evacuation in Jaku General Hospital's Patient Wards. General Studies, Support and Management students follow evacuation orders; an established Commission support assignment permits dispatch, supply or records work in Headquarters' Briefing Room, never automatic combat access.
Narrator only: protect Hawks's assignment; lab discoveries belong to witnesses, not every radio listener. Carry altered results forward without replaying a prevented injury.
The event is complete when the real Kyudai Garaki is caught and Shigaraki's pod is breaking, or intervention has conclusively resolved those two immediate objectives differently; any Headquarters attack has a recorded protection or casualty status.

war_villa.title: The Villa
war_villa.beats:
Day 363, immediately after The Dawn Raids, inside Gunga Mountain Villa: Hawks has Twice cornered in the Villa Great Hall while the raid presses inward. The Mountain Slopes still hold the student perimeter and Gigantomachia. Continue from the previous link's resolved positions; do not reset the hospital front.
