The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Hawks offers Twice surrender and tries to take him alive. Twice refuses to abandon his friends and fights to break through. Dabi intervenes; Hawks delivers the fatal strike by default. Keep Twice physically reachable through the confrontation until death is established, with room for restraint, rescue or a changed bargain. Twice's final double reaches Himiko Toga and Mr. Compress and saves them before dissolving. Its existence does not make the original Twice safe.
Dabi burns Hawks's wings and leaves him gravely injured. Fumikage Tokoyami doubles back from the perimeter, reaches Hawks, shields him with Dark Shadow and escapes with him. Let intervention change the rescue or the burns; Hawks goes to a hospital ward after stabilization, never away merely for being injured. Knowledge of his covert assignment remains confined to those who actually learn it here.
Gigantomachia wakes on the Mountain Slopes and starts toward Jaku, carrying Dabi, Himiko Toga, Spinner, Mr. Compress and Tomoyasu Chikazoku. Nemuri Kayama tries to stop him with Kamui Woods and Mount Lady. Skeptic's gas and Gigantomachia's violent passage cut off her approach; she falls injured among the attackers. She sends Momo Yaoyorozu the instruction to prepare anesthetic. Her death is the canon default unless someone reaches and protects her. Keep the fall site accessible to a nearby rescuer until her fate is established; being struck down alone never proves death.
By Path: at the Villa Great Hall, League of Villains Recruits can defend, seek Twice or flee. At the Villa Grounds and Mountain Slopes, licensed Class 1-A and Class 1-B students hold routes under faculty and pros, report Nemuri Kayama's last position or help Tokoyami carry Hawks. Licensed Pro Heroes, Sidekicks and Faculty can contest the giant or lead rescues. Independent Villains, Vigilantes and Civilians participate only if already on the mountain; other students gain no new deployment. Absent parties receive only reports their role can know.
The event is complete when Twice's confrontation and Hawks's extraction are resolved, Gigantomachia has begun his march or been stopped, and Nemuri Kayama's fall has a recorded rescue status or established fate.

war_jaku.title: Jaku
war_jaku.beats:
Day 363, after The Villa, at Jaku General Hospital's ruptured pod: Tomura Shigaraki wakes by canon default as evacuation continues across Jaku City. If prior intervention prevented his awakening, resolve the attempted awakening and rescue threat from that actual state; do not undo his capture. Carry forward Mirko's treatment, Garaki's custody and all altered villa results. No one returns to an earlier phase of the raid.
The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Decay tears through the Basement Service Levels and spreads into Jaku Downtown. Ryukyu and the others pull survivors clear. Crust throws a shield to save Shota Aizawa and dies in the spreading destruction by default unless intervention changes that instant. Keep him reachable during the last escape effort; establish death before removing him. Hospital patients and evacuation teams race beyond the advancing ground collapse.
Narrator only, private to direct participants: Shigaraki uses Search to hunt One For All. Izuku Midoriya and Katsuki Bakugo draw him away from the evacuation without telling bystanders what he wants. Aizawa's Erasure suppresses Shigaraki's Quirks but cannot remove his modified body's strength; Manual keeps Aizawa's eyes wet while Rock Lock guards him. Endeavor, Ryukyu and Gran Torino fight to hold the line. Shigaraki gravely wounds Gran Torino. A Quirk-destroying bullet strikes Aizawa's right leg; he cuts it off before the drug spreads, then suffers an eye injury that breaks his sustained gaze. Rescue and treatment can alter these consequences.
Izuku combines Float and Blackwhip to lift heroes clear of Decay. Katsuki shields Izuku from a piercing attack and is gravely wounded by default; retain him in play, supported and reachable, through the remaining battle. Shoto Todoroki reaches the fight and helps the injured. All For One reaches through Shigaraki for One For All; the vestige confrontation stays within the minds involved. Outsiders witness only the physical struggle.
By Path: licensed Hero Course students from both classes and their pros defend Jaku City's Residential Hills evacuation; Faculty, Licensed Pro Heroes and Sidekicks can reinforce the battle or extract casualties. Civilians can be trapped in Jaku General Hospital's Patient Wards or fleeing Jaku Downtown. Independent Villains and Vigilantes act only if already in Jaku. Villa recruits remain on their established front; General Studies, Support and Management students evacuate or continue established Commission support. No secret follows a general distress call.
The event is complete when the Decay escape and aerial clash are resolved, the immediate theft attempt has ended, and each endangered hero has a rescue status, while the wider battle remains active.

war_march.title: Gigantomachia's March
war_march.beats:
Day 363, after Jaku's immediate aerial clash, Gigantomachia advances from Gunga Mountain Villa toward the evacuation zone of Jaku City. The Jaku battle stays active at its resolved stage while the students' attempt to stop the giant takes focus; no earlier rescue or death is replayed.
The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: on Gunga Mountain Villa's Mountain Slopes, Momo Yaoyorozu turns Nemuri Kayama's last instruction into an anesthetic plan. Licensed students prepare doses, traps and a route to the giant's mouth. Mount Lady grapples with Gigantomachia and strains to hold his jaws apart while Kamui Woods and the perimeter team buy time. Class 1-A and Class 1-B coordinate rather than charging separately; Itsuka Kendo helps keep the teams organized.
Mina Ashido pushes through danger carrying a dose, then freezes when the giant brings back a towering villain she once faced before U.A.. Eijiro Kirishima shields her, takes up the dropped dose, climbs into reach and gets anesthetic into Gigantomachia's mouth. Others' failed throws do not erase his delivery. The dose is delivered by canon default, but it needs time to work; the giant breaks onward rather than instantly falling asleep. A player can change the delivery, strength of the delay or escape route. Record machia_dosed only if a dose actually reaches him.
The giant carries the Front's leaders toward Jaku City, crushing streets and forcing rescue teams to redirect evacuees. Himiko Toga leaves his back, enters Jaku's evacuation area and lures Ochaco Uraraka away under a civilian disguise. She demands to know whether heroes will kill her as Twice was killed. Ochaco confronts the harm Toga inflicts on others; Toga attacks and seeks a personal answer, not a public debate. Tsuyu Asui reaches Ochaco; Toga escapes by default. Their private exchange does not become general news.
By Path: licensed Hero Course students hold the mountain perimeter under their pros or evacuate Jaku City's Residential Hills. Faculty, Licensed Pro Heroes and Sidekicks can hold the giant, deliver a dose, clear debris or defend evacuees. League of Villains Recruits protect the riders or find their own escape; Independent Villains and Vigilantes act only if already on these fronts. Civilians flee or seek rescue. General Studies, Support and Management students stay with evacuation or an established Commission supply or dispatch role.
The event is complete when the dosing attempt and Toga's confrontation have resolved and the giant's next position is established, without requiring his capture or the war's end.

war_dabi.title: Toya Todoroki
war_dabi.beats:
Day 363, after Gigantomachia's March: the giant reaches Jaku City's battlefield by canon default, bringing Dabi and the remaining riders into sight of Endeavor and Shoto Todoroki. Start with the giant's actual progress and the dosing result; if play stopped him, stage Dabi's attempted disclosure from his reachable position instead of teleporting him.
The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Dabi exposes his white hair and names himself Toya Todoroki, Endeavor's eldest son, whom the family believed dead. He addresses Endeavor and Shoto directly while Tomoyasu Chikazoku, known as Skeptic, distributes Dabi's prerecorded statement across public screens and broadcasts. The recording accuses Endeavor of abusing his family in pursuit of a stronger successor and uses Hawks's killing of Twice to attack the legitimacy of heroes. Dabi also claims Hawks killed Best Jeanist. Treat that last claim as an allegation; Best Jeanist's return belongs to the next event.
Endeavor freezes under the revelation, unable to answer or resume command. Shoto confronts Dabi in the air and tries to keep his flames off the wounded. Dabi pushes the fight toward mutual destruction and further burns his own body. Nearby heroes must protect casualties, contain the fire and decide how to act while the accusations spread. Neither family reconciliation nor public judgment can be settled in this encounter.
The broadcast is public by design: listeners may learn Dabi's announced identity and accusations without being at the fight. It does not confirm every assertion, expose Hawks's Commission assignment or reveal One For All. The Todoroki family's unbroadcast memories remain private. Intervention can disrupt transmission, protect its targets, interrupt the duel or change what evidence actually reaches the public; preserve the delivered content rather than granting universal knowledge of an intercepted recording.
By Path: in Jaku Downtown, Faculty, Licensed Pro Heroes and Sidekicks can cover the faltering line or rescue the injured; licensed Hero Course students from either class continue assigned rescue and perimeter work, with Shoto at the duel. League of Villains Recruits can support the riders or withdraw. Independent Villains and Vigilantes join only if already in Jaku. Civilians in the Residential Hills meet the warning through evacuation screens or phones. General Studies, Support and Management students remain evacuated or in established Commission support and respond only to information actually received.
The event is complete when Dabi's identity claim and recording have been delivered, interrupted or prevented and the immediate Shoto-Dabi exchange has reached a break, with the war still unresolved.

paranormal_liberation_war.title: The End of the War
paranormal_liberation_war.beats:
Day 363, immediately after Toya Todoroki: Jaku City's heroes face the giant, the League and further Nomu. Continue the resolved broadcast, wounds and anesthetic status; Gunga Mountain Villa's remaining defenders are still under pressure from the raid.
The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Best Jeanist returns alive over Jaku Downtown and binds Gigantomachia and the League with heavy fibers, publicly overturning Dabi's allegation that Hawks killed him. Mirio Togata arrives with Permeation restored. Narrator only: Eri's practiced Rewind restored him before this deployment; the child remains protected at U.A. Academy, never brought into the fighting. Mirio supports the exhausted heroes against Nomu. Katsuki Bakugo, still gravely hurt and supported, tells Best Jeanist his chosen name: Great Explosion Murder God Dynamight. Do not heal him or remove him before this exchange merely because his injury flag is set.
If machia_dosed records a real delivery, the anesthetic finally takes effect and the giant collapses into custody under Best Jeanist's restraints. Without a dose, require another earned means of stopping him. Mr. Compress removes portions of his own body to escape the fibers and free his friends, accepting grave injury; heroes capture him alive and stabilize him before secure medical custody. Spinner rouses Tomura Shigaraki. Narrator only, private to the struggle: All For One takes control through Shigaraki, repels pursuit and escapes with him, Dabi, Spinner and Tomoyasu Chikazoku under Nomu cover by default. Himiko Toga also escapes, separately from that extraction after her earlier clash; do not place her back on the giant. Izuku Midoriya's Danger Sense awakens amid the danger; its origin remains private.
At Gunga Mountain Villa, the raid's heroes defeat Rikiya Yotsubashi, known as Re-Destro, and Geten, and the remaining Front fighters face arrest. Carry these captures alongside Jaku's conclusion, not as a second war day. No prison breakout happens here.
By Path: licensed students from Class 1-A and Class 1-B protect evacuees or assist their pros on their existing front. Faculty, Licensed Pro Heroes and Sidekicks bind, pursue or triage. League Recruits can aid escape or surrender at Jaku City or Gunga Mountain Villa; Independent Villains and Vigilantes act only where already present. Civilians seek safety; other U.A. courses remain evacuated or in established Commission support.
The event is complete when Shigaraki's escape or capture is resolved, Gigantomachia is stopped, and immediate combat ends on both fronts with custody and casualty transfers assigned.

war_casualty_roll.title: The Names After the Battle
war_casualty_roll.beats:
Day 364, Saturday morning, March 29, after The End of the War: rescue work continues in Jaku City and at Gunga Mountain Villa. Musutafu General Hospital receives casualties; U.A. Academy waits for verified names. Respect every earlier rescue, escape and death rather than restoring the default roster.
The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: teams search Jaku Downtown and the Residential Hills for trapped residents, patients and missing responders. At Gunga Mountain Villa's Mountain Slopes, students reach Nemuri Kayama's fall site and learn that she died unless the story established a rescue. Momo Yaoyorozu, Mina Ashido and Eijiro Kirishima face the loss of the teacher whose last order they followed. Give them work, silence, anger or grief without prescribing a single reaction. A missing report alone never proves a death, and any unresolved rescue remains playable until confirmation.
At Musutafu General Hospital, Izuku Midoriya, Katsuki Bakugo, Endeavor, Shoto Todoroki, Hawks, Mirko, Shota Aizawa and Gran Torino fill Patient Rooms by default. Izuku is unconscious; Katsuki needs treatment for his impalement, Shoto for burns, Endeavor for severe battle injuries and Hawks for his burned wings. Mirko's left forearm loss and damaged right leg require surgery and rehabilitation; record the right-leg amputation once treatment establishes it. Aizawa needs treatment for his amputated right leg and injured eye. Gran Torino survives with grave wounds. Hospitalization does not mark any of them dead or erase an established recovery difference.
News confirms that a double of Rikiya Yotsubashi attacked Hero Public Safety Commission Headquarters on the war day and killed the Commission President by canon default, leaving operations crippled. This is yesterday's reported attack, not a new morning battle. Use the protection or casualty status recorded at The Dawn Raids. If Commission-side intervention saved her, report that result instead; do not relocate the original Re-Destro from custody.
By Path: licensed Hero Course students from both classes assist supervised searches at Jaku City or Gunga Mountain Villa; Faculty, Licensed Pro Heroes and Sidekicks lead recovery and handover. Civilians identify relatives or receive care. League Recruits and already-present Independent Villains or Vigilantes handle their established escape, custody or rescue state. At U.A. Academy, General Studies, Support and Management students receive verified notices; established Commission support can reconcile records, supplies or displaced residents. Eri stays protected away from casualty scenes.
The event is complete when the search area is handed over and the dead, rescued and missing are recorded, with surviving wounded assigned to hospital care.

tartarus_falls.title: The Prison Opens
tartarus_falls.beats:
Before dawn on March 29, alarms interrupt Tartarus while its prisoners remain locked inside. Lady Nagant, Overhaul, Muscular and Stain are among those confined. Shigaraki's Sensei remains in the Maximum-Security Cell Block; Tomura Shigaraki approaches from outside with Near High-End Nomu. At Tartarus Transfer Port, staff receive broken communications. U.A. Academy receives an emergency warning while its injured students are still recovering.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the consciousness controlling Tomura Shigaraki coordinates the exterior assault with the imprisoned original body. An electromagnetic attack and pressure from both sides defeat safeguards designed to withstand an ordinary breakout. Guards face lethal danger, doors open and prisoners make separate choices about escape. Lady Nagant helps the armless Overhaul leave. Muscular seeks renewed violence; Stain moves independently and obtains information from the prison. The original All For One escapes, and subsequent attacks on other prisons spread the crisis. Both enemy bodies remain distinct people in distinct places. Kurogiri is not released by this assault.

Make a local objective concrete: keep a control station functioning, open an evacuation route, prevent a particular release or secure a departing vessel. A successful intervention can save guards or retain prisoners without automatically defeating every attacker. Prisoners remain reachable until they actually leave. Carry any prevented escape into later encounters rather than producing another copy of the escapee.

By Path: at Tartarus or Tartarus Transfer Port, Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero defend extraction routes; League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain can escape, recruit or resist the attackers. At U.A. Academy, Class 1-A and Class 1-B protect recovering people, General Studies handles notices, Support restores communications, Management verifies alerts and Faculty secures the shelter. Vigilante and Civilian Life can protect arrivals or seek missing relatives from their present site. Detained players receive a custody decision, not automatic freedom.

The event is complete when the assault and the player's local emergency have resolved, with specific survivors, captives and escapees identified directly or through a confirmed report.

todoroki_hospital_reckoning.title: A Family Faces Toya
todoroki_hospital_reckoning.beats:
On March 30, Endeavor is awake in Musutafu General Hospital, badly injured and unable to face the consequences of Dabi's broadcast. Shoto Todoroki, Rei Todoroki, Fuyumi Todoroki and Natsuo Todoroki gather for a protected visit. The conversation can extend through April 1 as treatment allows. At U.A. Academy, classmates encounter Shoto's absence and requests for privacy rather than hearing the family's private conversation automatically.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the family confronts the fact that Dabi is Toya. Their recollections expose Endeavor's coercive expectations, the damage of his obsession with surpassing All Might, Toya's dangerous training and the family's failures to reach him before the fire. Rei refuses to let Endeavor's collapse settle the matter or leave Shoto carrying it alone. Fuyumi hopes for cooperation; Natsuo's anger and refusal to forgive remain legitimate. Shoto resolves to stop his brother. Agreement to confront Toya together does not establish reconciliation or excuse abuse.

Give an invited participant room to interrupt a harmful exchange, request a break, challenge an account or help someone leave. Staff can protect the visit without deciding its emotional outcome. Hawks and Best Jeanist subsequently seek practical cooperation against Dabi and the larger threat; their arrival follows the family exchange rather than turning it into a press briefing. Endeavor remains a patient, Hawks remains injured and no one acquires unrestricted medical clearance through resolve alone.

By Path: at Musutafu General Hospital, Class 1-A can support Shoto with his consent, Class 1-B can cover recovery duties, General Studies can help reception, Support can prepare accessible equipment and Management can divert unwanted press. Faculty arranges protected visits; Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero maintain security and coverage. At U.A. Academy, the same Paths receive only authorized updates. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain may answer Dabi's public account through existing contacts; Vigilante and Civilian Life can counter harassment or assist relatives without access to the bedside discussion.

The event is complete when the visit ends with the family's next steps, each person's boundaries and the permitted recipients of private information stated.

hero_society_fractures.title: Who Still Answers?
hero_society_fractures.beats:
On April 1, Musutafu Station District faces another emergency with too few responders. Frightened residents carry support weapons, abandoned patrol calls accumulate at Hero Agency Row and U.A. Academy receives more shelter requests. Tokyo Broadcasting Center prepares coverage of the remaining leading heroes' response. Let the local crisis and its follow-up unfold through April 5 rather than compressing every resignation into one street encounter.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: residents trying to defend themselves injure neighbors or damage escape routes through poorly controlled attacks. Remaining heroes still rescue them despite abuse and distrust. Resignations leave further gaps, including Yoroi Musha's retirement. Endeavor, Hawks and Best Jeanist answer publicly for the crisis: Endeavor accepts responsibility for his family's suffering, Hawks addresses his actions and background, and Best Jeanist's survival refutes the allegation that Hawks murdered him. Their promise is continued action, not instant restoration of public confidence.

The player can disarm an unsafe confrontation, persuade holdouts to accept help, keep an agency operating or demand a credible protection plan. Demonstrate the cost of each choice through staffing, shelter capacity and medical needs. Rumors about One For All can circulate, but a resident's question does not supply its transfer history or Izuku's location. Private planning and patient information remain restricted. A prevented retirement changes coverage; it cannot fill every empty agency by itself.

By Path: at Musutafu Station District, Class 1-A and Class 1-B undertake supervised rescue, Vigilante intervenes in armed disorder and Civilian Life decides how to assist neighbors. At U.A. Academy, General Studies manages intake, Support repairs defenses, Management verifies announcements and Faculty organizes shelter capacity. At Hero Agency Row, Licensed Sidekick handles abandoned calls while Licensed Pro Hero commits actual staff and resources. At Tokyo Broadcasting Center, authorized participants can challenge claims or protect accurate reporting. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain can recruit, exploit the shortage or protect a district from their current site; they do not receive the heroes' private conference.

The event is complete when the immediate neighborhood emergency is resolved and a named service, shelter or local group has accepted the continuing protection duties.

last_bearer_leaves_home.title: The Empty Dorm Room
last_bearer_leaves_home.beats:
On April 6, Izuku Midoriya wakes in Musutafu General Hospital while his classmates wait for news at U.A. Academy. His arms remain scarred and his body is still recovering. All Might and Inko Midoriya must confront his intention to pursue the enemy outside the shelter. Gran Torino remains a seriously injured patient, available for a protected bedside conversation rather than another field assignment.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: within One For All, its predecessors explain that the accumulated power shortens the lives of holders who already possess a Quirk. Izuku's original Quirklessness may make him its last suitable bearer. Asked whether he can kill Tomura Shigaraki, he insists on trying to reach the suffering person he perceived within him. This interior exchange is private; a hospital visitor cannot hear it or enter the vestige space merely by being nearby.

Izuku accepts Gran Torino's yellow cape and leaves his established home at Heights Alliance. Letters explain One For All to Class 1-A and explain why he believes remaining would endanger them. All Might, Endeavor, Hawks and Best Jeanist support the pursuit, despite disagreement over its risks. His provisional license is not erased. Inko receives an actual conversation about danger and support, not a silent demand to approve. A participant can argue for rest, a different base, escorts or a protected arrangement at the Academy; accepting help must create practical commitments.

By Path: at Musutafu General Hospital, Faculty, Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero can negotiate medical and operational safeguards; Civilian Life can support Inko with consent. At U.A. Academy, Class 1-A responds to the letters, Class 1-B covers recovery duties, General Studies seeks permitted contact, Support prepares equipment and Management protects private correspondence. Vigilante can seek a safe contact route. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain receive only information their contacts actually provide about the hunt. No Path gains the letters or vestige history automatically. Keep an absent or detained player involved through an authorized message or cooperation decision.

The event is complete when Izuku has departed or accepted a different supported arrangement, with his destination category, medical limits, escorts and each recipient's knowledge explicitly established.

muscular_returns.title: A Familiar Monster
muscular_returns.beats:
On April 9, Yo Shindo and Tatami Nakagame attempt to move holdout residents away from Musutafu Highway Outlets. Muscular interrupts the appeal before the reluctant civilians have committed to evacuation. He is loose only if the Tartarus assault or another established escape freed him. U.A. Academy receives the rescue alert; Musutafu Police Headquarters prepares a secure handover rather than assuming the fugitive has already been recaptured.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Shindo tries to stop Muscular and suffers serious injuries, but his vibrations weaken the villain's muscle defenses. Tatami works to protect him while the residents discover the immediate cost of remaining outside shelter. Izuku Midoriya arrives, recognizes the opponent and refuses to give him another victim. Using the inherited abilities available to him, he exploits Shindo's opening, defeats Muscular and delivers him into custody. Witnesses see unusual abilities and a masked rescuer; observation alone does not reveal One For All's transfer or its predecessors.

Keep Shindo reachable for extraction and treatment throughout the confrontation. A player can exploit the weakened fibers, protect Tatami, evacuate residents or secure restraints; each contribution has a bounded effect. Muscular's desire for violence makes negotiation difficult without making the player's actions irrelevant. If he escapes or has never escaped Tartarus, resolve the actual danger and communicate the changed custody situation instead of manufacturing a duplicate battle. Residents may still refuse relocation, but a continuing protection arrangement must then be explicit.

By Path: at Musutafu Highway Outlets, Licensed Sidekick extracts Shindo, Licensed Pro Hero directs containment, Vigilante assists rescue and Civilian Life chooses evacuation or aids neighbors. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain can aid Muscular, obstruct him or abandon his pursuit. At U.A. Academy, Class 1-A and Class 1-B assist through approved rescue work, General Studies contacts holdouts, Support supplies extraction tools, Management communicates routes and Faculty authorizes assistance. At Musutafu Police Headquarters, authorized participants arrange custody and medical transfer. Remote participants stay at their assigned sites until a real journey is established.

The event is complete when Muscular's immediate threat has ended, Shindo's medical destination is known and the residents' evacuation or continuing protection has been decided.

rain_patrols.title: The People Between Shelters
rain_patrols.beats:
On April 14, rain empties Musutafu Station District while frightened residents mistake a tall heteromorphic woman for a threat. She is an unnamed civilian, not an enemy encounter. Izuku Midoriya hears the confrontation during patrol; All Might is nearby with transport and supplies. At U.A. Academy, shelter workers face reports of people still stranded outside. Follow-up patrols can carry this pressure through April 22 without replaying the same assault every day.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Izuku stops the attackers, listens to the woman and helps arrange safe passage. All Might provides practical reassurance and transport toward refuge. Her appearance has made her vulnerable to suspicion and rejection; it does not justify an additional security burden beyond the ordinary shelter process. She later has a personal reason to recognize and defend Izuku. Preserve that relationship only if this rescue or an established alternative actually creates it.

Further patrols yield endangered people and exhausted responders but little reliable information about All For One. Meals, replacement gear and human contact become increasingly difficult for All Might to deliver. Izuku's costume gathers damage and dirt, his rest shortens and his habit of moving on before support arrives becomes visible. A participant can insist on a meal, arrange a check-in or share an escort duty. Such help can reduce exhaustion; the story must not silently discard it to recreate a predetermined collapse.

By Path: at Musutafu Station District, Vigilante can interrupt the assault, Civilian Life can challenge neighbors or offer shelter, and Licensed Sidekick or Licensed Pro Hero can escort refugees and redistribute coverage. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain may scout the patrol, manipulate fear or choose to protect the threatened woman. At U.A. Academy, Class 1-A and Class 1-B gather permitted accounts, General Studies assists displaced residents, Support maintains field equipment, Management corrects false alerts and Faculty negotiates protected admission. These roles can produce useful contact without revealing Izuku's live route publicly. A player at the shelter receives the escort request rather than appearing instantly beside the assault.

The event is complete when the threatened people reach an explicitly accepted refuge and the next patrol contact, rest arrangement or support obligation has been settled.

lady_nagant_contract.title: The Assassin Above the Rain
lady_nagant_contract.beats:
On April 23, a precision shot destroys Izuku Midoriya's communications above Hosu Downtown. Lady Nagant demands surrender from a position on the rooftops; the armless Overhaul waits nearby, dependent on her help. All Might faces separate attackers on the approach. U.A. Academy can receive a missed check-in or an authorized response request, not a live transcript of the sniper's conversation.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Nagant uses Rifle and the Air Walk granted by All For One to capture Izuku alive. She changes firing angles through the air and uses calculated pressure rather than an indiscriminate massacre. Her account reveals to those actually present the covert killings she performed for the former Public Safety Commission, her disillusionment and the killing that led to her imprisonment. This history is not automatically public, and listening to it does not excuse the current attack.

Izuku uses the inherited abilities available to him, including Fa Jin's stored motion, to close the distance. When Nagant fires toward Overhaul to test his rescue instinct, he saves the helpless man and reaches her remaining willingness to believe in heroes. Overhaul remains alive and armless; his demand to see the former Hassaikai boss does not establish repentance. The player can disrupt a firing line, extract a bystander, help All Might, protect Overhaul or attempt a different appeal. Keep the contract and its concealed dangers unresolved beyond what the confrontation actually reveals. If Nagant never escaped, use the established source of the threat and report her continuing custody rather than releasing her retroactively.

By Path: at Hosu Downtown, Licensed Sidekick approaches through cover, Licensed Pro Hero organizes containment, Vigilante protects bystanders and Civilian Life reports shots or shelters casualties. League of Villains Recruit can support or question the contract; Independent Villain can attempt a rival capture or aid an escape. At U.A. Academy, Class 1-A and Class 1-B assist through approved assignments, General Studies traces interrupted contact, Support restores communications, Management protects the incident channel and Faculty coordinates extraction. Participation elsewhere requires an established journey.

The event is complete when the confrontation and attempted rescue have resolved, with Nagant's decision about the contract, Overhaul's immediate safety and the recipients of her disclosures established.

nagant_and_the_mansion_trap.title: The Price of Changing Sides
nagant_and_the_mansion_trap.beats:
As the confrontation's immediate aftermath reaches April 24, Lady Nagant is still above Hosu Downtown when concealed enemy punishment threatens her. Izuku Midoriya is close enough to attempt a rescue; Hawks approaches the fall. Musutafu General Hospital receives an emergency request, while Endeavor Hero Agency becomes a coordination point for acting on any intelligence Nagant can provide. Carry forward a different allegiance or custody outcome from the previous encounter.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Nagant's body erupts after she turns toward cooperation. Hawks catches her and the heroes obtain emergency treatment. Keep the warning, fall and transfer playable; intervention may reduce the injuries or prevent the detonation if the story establishes a credible means. By default she survives with extensive burns and other severe injuries. Overhaul is secured separately, still armless, and Izuku challenges his selective desire to apologize without treating it as forgiveness for his abuse.

Nagant's information leads the pursuit team to a remote mansion. Their search finds a recorded message from All For One rather than the man himself, followed by a destructive explosion. The player participates there only through an established journey with the team; otherwise the approach, warning and aftermath arrive through authorized communications at the event's sites. Do not substitute Gunga Mountain Villa for this separate hideout. A successful search can preserve evidence, evacuate teammates or defeat the trap, but the recorded speaker does not become physically present. The attack increases Izuku's fear that anyone near him will be hurt, unless effective support changes that response.

By Path: at Hosu Downtown, Licensed Sidekick, Licensed Pro Hero and Vigilante can catch, shield or extract casualties; Civilian Life assists emergency access. At Musutafu General Hospital, Class 1-A and Class 1-B support approved response duties, General Studies tracks transfers and Faculty protects treatment. At Endeavor Hero Agency, Support inspects communications and Management preserves verified intelligence. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain can assess the treatment of defectors, recover evidence or withhold warnings through existing contacts. None of these roles grants Nagant's private history automatically.

The event is complete when patients and detainees are handed over and a direct or confirmed report establishes the mansion's trap, casualties and usable evidence.

dictator_and_the_lost_hero.title: Too Tired to Stand
dictator_and_the_lost_hero.beats:
On May 1, Izuku Midoriya reaches Kamino Ward's Shopping Street in a filthy, damaged costume, struggling to keep moving. By default he has pushed All Might away and evaded the support team; preserve any support the player actually kept in place. Dictator waits behind a crowd of civilians controlled through Despot. At U.A. Academy, Class 1-A's effort to find Izuku has become an authorized retrieval operation rather than an ordinary outing.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Dictator forces people to surround and attack Izuku. They remain victims even when their bodies obstruct him. Izuku looks for a solution that does not injure them, but his exhaustion makes coordination difficult. Dictator counts on that restraint until Katsuki Bakugo intervenes from above and disables him. The controlled crowd is released, and Class 1-A reaches its friend. Their arrival resolves the immediate ambush, not the argument over whether Izuku will return.

Allow the player to locate the controller, remove people from danger, protect a falling victim or create a clean opening. A villain-aligned participant can support the ambush, expose Dictator or decline to help either side. Track injuries from any attack through the crowd, including friendly attacks. If Dictator was retained in custody after Tartarus, do not release him solely to stage this encounter: establish his absence through the pursuit report and resolve the classmates' actual contact with Izuku. A healthier Izuku responds with the stamina earned by earlier interventions.

By Path: at Kamino Ward, Class 1-A can join retrieval, Licensed Sidekick removes civilians, Licensed Pro Hero secures Dictator, Vigilante protects extraction and Civilian Life can survive control or help victims. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain decide whether to aid the ambush or exploit its failure. At U.A. Academy, Class 1-B covers rescue obligations, General Studies identifies missing residents, Support prepares restraints, Management coordinates reception and Faculty monitors the retrieval. Remote participants receive concrete tasks and reports instead of being transported into the crowd. The class's knowledge of One For All remains confidential.

The event is complete when Dictator can no longer control the immediate crowd, the victims' care and his custody or escape are established, and Izuku's classmates have reached him or received an explicit changed contact outcome.

deku_versus_class_a.title: Take Our Hands
deku_versus_class_a.beats:
Immediately after the ambush on May 1, Class 1-A faces Izuku Midoriya in Kamino Ward. He is still exhausted and tries to leave before his friends can become targets. Katsuki Bakugo, Tenya Iida and Ochaco Uraraka are among those trying to keep him within reach. U.A. Academy prepares for a possible return without announcing that the shelter has already agreed to admit him.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Izuku attempts to escape using the abilities now available to him. His classmates coordinate pursuit, obstacles and restraint while recalling specific ways he helped them. Their purpose is contact and shared responsibility, not punishment for leaving. Several approaches fail before the class combines its strengths to launch Iida within reach. Iida catches Izuku's hand, turning their earlier rescue connection back toward him. Bakugo then acknowledges his bullying and apologizes directly rather than disguising it as another insult.

Give a participating classmate or player a real place in the coordination: protect the landing, provide an opening, make a personal appeal or offer a workable escort plan. Izuku can listen before the final interception; successful support need not be defeated to reproduce the chase. Restraint must account for his injuries, and promises require actual people willing to share patrol, rest and danger. Bakugo's apology belongs to him and need not demand immediate forgiveness. The default is that Izuku accepts collective help and collapses into care, not that his physical exhaustion disappears.

By Path: at Kamino Ward, Class 1-A participates directly, Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero protect the perimeter, Vigilante keeps the return route open and Civilian Life offers practical help. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain can report, suppress or exploit the reunion only if they have actually learned its location. At U.A. Academy, Class 1-B prepares reception, General Studies locates rest facilities, Support arranges medical equipment, Management clears arrival communications and Faculty supports the retrieval decision. The class's private discussion of One For All stays within its established listeners. Anyone elsewhere receives the team's report and must travel before taking a physical role.

The event is complete when Izuku accepts return with his friends or another explicit supported arrangement, with the escort, immediate care and any unresolved objections stated.

ua_gate_appeal.title: A Place to Rest
ua_gate_appeal.beats:
On May 2, U.A. Academy's Main Gate becomes the boundary between an exhausted rescuer and frightened refugees. Izuku Midoriya arrives with Class 1-A, but residents object that admitting him will draw Tomura Shigaraki to their families. Inko Midoriya waits among the people inside. Kota Izumi is present as a protected child with trusted adults nearby; he is never assigned to contain the crowd or defend the gate.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Principal Nezu explains the strengthened barrier and evacuation system. Underground shelter sections and transport arrangements offer real protection, but engineering alone does not answer residents who have already lost their homes. Ochaco Uraraka takes an elevated speaking position and describes Izuku's condition, asking them to let him rest at his Academy. She does not publicly explain One For All's transfer or its private history. Residents know that he is a particular enemy target; that knowledge is not consent to every operational secret.

Kota and the heteromorphic woman Izuku previously rescued recognize the person behind the frightening costume and step forward. Preserve their recognition only where the earlier rescues occurred or a valid alternative established it. Their testimony helps the residents accept his return by default. Opposition may remain without making every refugee cruel or irrational. A player can question evacuation capacity, testify to a rescue, maintain a safe corridor or propose a protection commitment. Any alternative admission decision must include a real place for Izuku to recover and continuing safety for the shelter population.

By Path: Class 1-A stands with Izuku, Class 1-B assists residents, General Studies facilitates discussion, Support explains equipment within its knowledge and Management maintains amplification and a channel for questions. Faculty addresses safeguards, Licensed Sidekick preserves safe access and Licensed Pro Hero commits actual protection. Vigilante can testify to witnessed rescues; Civilian Life can oppose or support admission and help neighbors understand the options. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain act only through access or contacts already established, deciding whether to report what they observe. Do not admit a hostile outsider into restricted areas merely because the scene has begun.

The event is complete when admission and immediate recovery arrangements are decided, the crowd has a safe next step and the player's continuing shelter or protection duty is clear.

stain_and_the_return_home.title: What Remains of All Might
stain_and_the_return_home.beats:
Later on May 2, All Might stands in Kamino Ward, confronting the apparent uselessness of a former symbol who could not keep his student beside him. Moko Tamashi tends the memorial associated with his final public rescue. Stain approaches independently. At U.A. Academy, Izuku Midoriya finally has a chance to wash, eat and rest, provided the preceding admission decision allows it.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Stain challenges All Might's despair and directs his attention toward Moko's ordinary act of care. Her continued gratitude demonstrates that saving someone has consequences beyond a hero's ability to win another fight. Stain's argument does not make his murders acceptable or turn him into a licensed ally. All Might can hear the challenge while still opposing him. The player may protect Moko's privacy, challenge Stain, secure the exchange or help All Might recognize the work he can still do.

Stain hands over information stolen from Tartarus. Through analysis and comparison with other intelligence, it reveals that the enemy's completion timetable is much shorter than expected. It is not a public document automatically understood by everyone at the memorial. If Stain remained imprisoned, was intercepted or lost the material, establish whether another credible delivery exists and retain any delay. At the Academy, classmates help Izuku clean up and rest; he and All Might reconcile when they actually meet. Remove the filthy patrol presentation after washing, but preserve scars, fatigue and the need for treatment.

By Path: at Kamino Ward, Vigilante can encounter the confrontation, Civilian Life can maintain the memorial, and Licensed Sidekick or Licensed Pro Hero can secure a route or receive an authorized handover. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain can pursue the intelligence only through witnessed information or existing contacts. At U.A. Academy, Class 1-A and Class 1-B offer companionship, General Studies supports shelter routines, Support assesses costume damage, Management protects delivery and Faculty evaluates the shortened deadline. All Might's restored purpose should create practical planning work, not a return of his lost power. Anyone learning the outcome remotely receives only the appropriate personal or operational report.

The event is complete when Izuku has an explicit recovery arrangement and the Tartarus information has reached the planners, been lost or been delayed under a stated alternative.

star_and_stripe_last_order.title: The Rule That Fights Back
star_and_stripe_last_order.beats:
On May 3, Star and Stripe approaches Japan over the Pacific with Ethan Drive and her trusted fighter squadron. Tomura Shigaraki intercepts them before they can join the Japanese heroes. At Yokohama Harbor District, the coastal response receives urgent communications; U.A. Academy awaits international assistance. The aerial combatants remain offshore. A shore participant needs an established flight or extraction route to reach them physically.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Star combines New Order's limited simultaneous rules with the pilots' coordinated attacks. She can strengthen herself and impose conditions on touched targets, but her attempt to name Shigaraki fails against his unstable identity. The battle escalates through a vast atmospheric construct, concentrated lasers and incoming military missiles. He survives by exploiting the blast and closes on the squadron. Star refuses to sacrifice a trusted pilot merely to secure a final strike.

Keep Star reachable through the live battle, warning and possible extraction until her death is established. By default, Shigaraki touches her, steals New Order and kills her through Decay. Her prepared final rule makes New Order revolt against the other Quirks inside him. It destroys itself while damaging his stockpile, so the enemy does not retain it as a permanent asset. The surviving pilots preserve combat data and report the damage, buying the heroes additional preparation time. A player can change the interception, rescue Star or preserve different evidence; resolve the Quirk's actual fate and resulting delay rather than granting both sides incompatible victories.

By Path: at Yokohama Harbor District, Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero organize coastal response, Vigilante protects exposed communities and Civilian Life follows alerts or assists reception. League of Villains Recruit can support the enemy's recovery through existing contacts; Independent Villain can exploit the protection gap or interfere. At U.A. Academy, Class 1-A and Class 1-B prepare under alert, General Studies assists communications, Support analyzes supplied data, Management handles liaison and Faculty revises readiness. Remote aid remains useful without becoming an instant journey offshore. The pilots' detailed findings reach authorized planners, while the public receives confirmed casualty and assistance announcements.

The event is complete when the aerial battle ends and Star's survival or death, New Order's fate, the pilots' condition and the resulting preparation interval reach the relevant sides.

aoyama_exposed.title: The Friend in the Woods
aoyama_exposed.beats:
On May 4, Toru Hagakure notices Yuga Aoyama's distress and follows him toward the wooded edge of U.A. Academy's Athletics Field. Mr. Aoyama and Mrs. Aoyama meet him there, believing their conversation private. Izuku Midoriya can be brought to the discovery through Hagakure's warning. Other students continue preparation elsewhere until a witness or alarm gives them a reason to respond.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Hagakure overhears the parents discussing All For One's demands. They obtained Navel Laser for their originally Quirkless son and have obeyed threats against the family. Their conversation and subsequent admissions expose Yuga's role in supplying information connected to the USJ and forest training-camp attacks. Coercion explains the pressure without erasing the people harmed. Hagakure is the discoverer, not the traitor; suspicion must follow actual evidence rather than her invisibility.

Yuga panics when confronted and fires his laser in despair. Izuku and Hagakure prevent his escape and further injury. Refraction briefly reveals Hagakure's appearance without making her permanently visible. Keep the confrontation nonsexualized and focused on protection, fear and betrayal. A participant can interrupt the shot, preserve a device, obtain an admission or calm a parent before restraint becomes necessary. The family remains alive and reachable. Staff and police take control through an actual response; neither a confession nor a classmate's sympathy constitutes a completed investigation.

By Path: Class 1-A can confront or support Yuga; Class 1-B secures adjacent grounds; General Studies reports suspicious contact; Support protects and examines devices; Management prevents unauthorized circulation of evidence. Faculty leads safeguarding and detention, Licensed Sidekick assists the transfer and Licensed Pro Hero assesses compromised operations. Vigilante can provide corroborating contact information, while Civilian Life can give testimony through an authorized channel. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain can attempt a warning or trade evidence only after actually learning of the exposure. Discovery within U.A. Academy does not immediately inform All For One or the public. Preserve that separation when deciding who may still be deceived.

The event is complete when the family is secured or its changed escape outcome is established, immediate injuries are addressed and the discovered evidence and its actual recipients are stated.

aoyama_second_chance.title: You Can Still Be a Hero
aoyama_second_chance.beats:
Later on May 4, U.A. Academy's Faculty Office becomes a controlled interview space for Yuga Aoyama and his parents. Naomasa Tsukauchi separates testimony from assumptions while Principal Nezu and All Might consider the security consequences. Izuku Midoriya and classmates can speak only when admitted. At Musutafu General Hospital, Shota Aizawa joins through a protected consultation while continuing treatment for the loss of his right eye and lower leg.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Yuga condemns himself as a villain and expects rejection. Izuku argues that the wrong he has done does not remove every chance to act heroically now. Classmates express anger, hurt and support without being required to forgive on command. Investigators assess the family's coercion, contact history and possible hidden enemy measures. Medical checks and communication restrictions matter because Nagant's punishment has demonstrated the danger of treating an apparent defection as safe.

Aizawa proposes that Yuga can help deceive All For One under supervision. Cooperation is a constrained role in an operation, not immunity, a public pardon or permission to resume unsupervised contact. Give a participating player a decision about evidence, willingness, safeguards or testimony; make clear which risks remain unresolved. Yuga and his parents can refuse or request limits. If the previous event established escape, a warning or compromised secrecy, this interview and any deception plan must respond to that reality rather than restoring an unsuspecting enemy.

By Path: at U.A. Academy, Class 1-A can address Yuga, Class 1-B covers disrupted duties, General Studies assists an authorized interview, Support examines equipment and Management restricts sensitive circulation. Faculty judges suitability and care, Licensed Sidekick escorts detainees and Licensed Pro Hero assesses tactical use. At Musutafu General Hospital, authorized participants can consult Aizawa and arrange medical safeguards without interrupting other patients. Vigilante and Civilian Life provide corroborating testimony through permitted contacts. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain decide whether to warn, cooperate or bargain only with information actually acquired. The operation's eventual details remain limited even among sympathetic students.

The event is complete when Yuga's willingness, the family's custody, the permitted cooperation and the recipients of the proposed deception have been decided.

final_war_workshop.title: Build a Battlefield
final_war_workshop.beats:
On May 5, Mei Hatsume and Power Loader work through urgent repairs in U.A. Academy's Development Studio. Planners use the brief interval won offshore to prepare separated battlefields. Training Ground Gamma hosts controlled rehearsals, while Musutafu General Hospital maintains guarded access to Kurogiri. Tasks can continue into May 6; the available time must follow the actual result of Star and Stripe's battle.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: support workers repair costumes and construct the systems that will lift U.A. Academy as the floating fortress Troy. Its containment surface, replacement material and power supply require continuous human labor. Students test repaired gear instead of receiving inexhaustible equipment. Command assigns teams to separate the enemy's strongest members, keeping civilian evacuation and operational transport distinct.

Neito Monoma practices copying Warp Gate from the captive Kurogiri and prepares to sustain copied Erasure for the later containment battle. He cannot use both simultaneously; deployment must allow a deliberate change of task and renewal of copied abilities within their limits. Shota Aizawa's injuries prevent his old continuous combat role. Hitoshi Shinso, still a General Studies student preparing for transfer, rehearses the improved Brainwashing needed for the Aoyama deception. Access to Kurogiri is guarded and medical, not a friendly visit. An alternative custody or cooperation outcome requires a revised transport and deception plan.

By Path: at U.A. Academy, Class 1-A and Class 1-B rehearse assignments, General Studies assists Shinso or logistics, Support fabricates and tests, Management allocates supplies and confidential rosters, and Faculty directs readiness. At Training Ground Gamma, Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero can test team procedures and agency equipment; Vigilante arranges compatible rescue coverage. At Musutafu General Hospital, authorized personnel protect patients and supervised copying. Civilian Life prepares evacuation necessities. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain can gather intelligence, sabotage or supply through established access, without automatically learning the whole operation. Choose one concrete player task and test its failure conditions; remote work cannot certify machinery nobody has inspected.

The event is complete when the player's preparation has been tested and accepted or explicitly rejected, with its supplies, personnel, limitations and any resulting revision to deployment stated.

league_before_the_end.title: The People They Mean to Destroy
league_before_the_end.beats:
On May 6, the villains prepare while the heroes complete their own assignments. Shigaraki's Sensei directs contacts from Nomu Warehouse; Spinner faces demands to become a public symbol. Kamino Ward offers a place to encounter recruitment and propaganda through existing contacts, while U.A. Academy receives only intelligence actually gathered. Himiko Toga's visit to her former home occurs elsewhere and is reached only through an established journey or a later account.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Toga revisits the home associated with her rejection. Dabi meets her there, burns the abandoned house and gives her the blood he preserved from Twice. The supply is finite. Twice remains dead; using his blood later does not revive him or produce unlimited reserves. Toga's grief and her unresolved response to Ochaco shape her preparation. Dabi remains intent on destroying Endeavor and the Todoroki family rather than embracing All For One's preferred future.

Spinner is elevated as a symbol for heteromorph anger and accepts additional Quirks. Their physical burden enlarges him and damages his ability to think and communicate. Preserve a chance to object, interrupt the process or offer a different role before those changes are established. Heteromorph grievances are real, but no community is automatically loyal to the League. Tomoyasu Chikazoku, acting as Skeptic, prepares technological infiltration. A player can preserve a warning, reject a recruitment demand or change a supply transfer without learning every hidden objective. The enemy's original body and Shigaraki remain separate.

By Path: at Nomu Warehouse, League of Villains Recruit can accompany preparations and choose loyalty, Independent Villain can negotiate participation and an authorized infiltrator can risk gathering evidence. At Kamino Ward, Vigilante investigates recruitment and Civilian Life can resist, join or protect someone being pressured. At U.A. Academy, Class 1-A and Class 1-B prepare against known opponents, General Studies documents threatened communities, Support analyzes verified capabilities, Management assesses propaganda and Faculty briefs teams. Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero investigate or allocate interception resources from their actual site. Private villain conversations are not included in general briefings; capture, detention or broken contact changes which scenes can occur.

The event is complete when the player's allegiance or response is settled and the relevant blood supply, Spinner's condition, infiltration preparations and intended targets are established for their actual witnesses.

leave_for_troy.title: One Last Night Before Deployment
leave_for_troy.beats:
On May 8, U.A. Academy's Campus Bus Terminal fills with checked equipment and quiet departures. Class 1-A prepares to leave the civilian shelter's daily life for temporary Troy accommodation and operational staging. Staff maintain refugee services while families say goodbye through permitted visits or messages. Heights Alliance has been the students' home since day one; this departure is neither their first dorm move nor a celebration of becoming residents.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the students' departure frustrates infiltrators who hoped to turn refugee opposition into a means of driving Izuku Midoriya out on enemy terms. The heroes choose their own movement and protect its purpose. U.A. Academy's preparation as the floating fortress Troy continues under restricted access. Refugees remain in protected accommodation and evacuation arrangements; they are not carried into the coming battlefield merely because students are billeted for the operation.

Before departure, Izuku and Ochaco Uraraka find a quiet chance to speak about the suffering they perceived in Tomura Shigaraki and Himiko Toga. Wanting to understand or save an enemy does not excuse the harm that enemy has caused. Their conversation is private unless shared deliberately. Shoto Todoroki carries his intention to face Dabi without requiring his classmates to solve the family's history. Friends share food, check equipment and make concrete commitments for the next day. Keep warmth and uncertainty together; no one knows the eventual casualties in advance.

By Path: at U.A. Academy, Class 1-A and Class 1-B prepare personal and team commitments, General Studies helps relocation, Support issues final equipment, Management reconciles confidential lists and Faculty oversees departure and shelter continuity. Licensed Sidekick escorts transport, Licensed Pro Hero briefs assigned teams and Vigilante protects an agreed route without receiving unrestricted orders. Civilian Life can say goodbye, pack essentials or accept an ongoing shelter duty. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain may observe, conceal or expose the move only through established access. A detained player receives a relevant cooperation or visitation decision. Equipment issued here remains finite, and earlier injuries, leaks or altered assignments must travel with the people affected.

The event is complete when the departure and protected handover are finished and the player has accepted an explicit deployment, support or civilian duty for the coming operation.

operation_troy_division.title: Separate Them
operation_troy_division.beats:
Day 405 opens at Troy's deployment perimeter. Yuga Aoyama appears to surrender Izuku Midoriya to Shigaraki's Sensei, now publicly known as All For One. The waiting heroes hold their positions until the enemy commits. Keep Aoyama's cooperation confined to the people actually briefed; the approaching villains initially believe the delivery is genuine.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Hitoshi Shinso's control allows the Aoyamas to perform their deception without ordinary deliberate lies betraying them. All For One summons his forces. Neito Monoma answers with copied Warp Gate, bringing the heroes into the confrontation. Rising barriers divide the enemy into groups and drive them through separate portals. All For One goes to Gunga, Tomura Shigaraki to the floating Academy, and Dabi to Kamino. Himiko Toga catches Izuku and pulls him into the Okuto deployment instead of his intended gate.

Make the separation playable through one threatened barrier, contested portal, or rescue decision. A player can protect a transport lane, disrupt a destination, follow an ally, or resist being moved. Establish the destination before changing scenes. Monoma subsequently takes up copied Erasure; he cannot keep supplying convenient portals while maintaining that duty. Preserve any earlier exposure, refusal, capture, or alliance that changes the trap.

By place: U.A. Academy handles deployment and the airborne arena; Okuto Island receives the island combatants; Kamino Ward receives the brothers' confrontation; Gunga Mountain Villa receives All For One. Musutafu General Hospital protects its patients and detainee, Jaku City guards Gigantomachia, and Takoba Municipal Stadium holds its assigned force. Mount Fuji Battlefield receives warnings and perimeter preparations, not an early final confrontation.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B execute assigned deployments; General Studies supports Shinso; Support operates barriers; Management checks arrivals; Faculty directs the split. Licensed Sidekick holds a lane and Licensed Pro Hero leads a team. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain can resist or exploit separation; Vigilante protects the perimeter; Civilian Life follows or challenges evacuation instructions. Remote and detained participants act through available communications.

The event is complete when the opening portals close and the player's actual destination, companions, and immediate assignment are established.

sky_coffin_first_contact.title: Hold Without Deku
sky_coffin_first_contact.beats:
On day 405, Tomura Shigaraki strikes the floating arena at U.A. Academy before its defenders receive Izuku Midoriya. Katsuki Bakugo, Best Jeanist, Mirko, Edgeshot, and the Big Three confront him. Above their protected position, Neito Monoma holds copied Erasure under Shota Aizawa's supervision while Manual keeps his eyes moistened. If the opening deployment changed, use the defenders and opponent who actually arrived.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Shigaraki produces an enormous mass of fingers and attacks with overwhelming physical strength despite Erasure. His bodily adaptation is not an ordinary activated Quirk that Monoma can simply cancel. The arena's electrified defenses and replaceable floor keep the threat contained only while the teams below maintain them. Momo Yaoyorozu supplies replacement material, Mei Hatsume's crews service the mechanisms, and Denki Kaminari helps sustain power.

Choose one immediate failure point: a damaged floor section, an exposed maintenance crew, or an approaching attack on the observers. Let the player's contribution buy measurable time or create a specific breach. Electricity does not make the enclosure invulnerable, and replacement panels do not appear without material and labor. Monoma cannot abandon Erasure to transport Izuku without releasing the enemy's suppressed powers. Injured defenders remain reachable for extraction rather than disappearing from the fight.

By place: at U.A. Academy, stage the arena or the maintenance compartment appropriate to the party. Okuto Island, Kamino Ward, and Gunga Mountain Villa receive urgent requests through battle communications. Musutafu General Hospital prepares casualty reception; Jaku City and Takoba Municipal Stadium retain their own opponents. Mount Fuji Battlefield handles falling-debris warnings and ground safety. Nobody crosses these distances through a radio exchange.

By Path: Class 1-A defends or powers the enclosure; Class 1-B protects replacement supplies. General Studies moves equipment, Support repairs machinery, Management prioritizes shortages, and Faculty coordinates the compartments. Licensed Sidekick shields crews; Licensed Pro Hero confronts Shigaraki. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain can attack or assist containment. Vigilante protects the ground perimeter; Civilian Life supports evacuation and emergency reception.

The event is complete when the first assault is contained or a specific section fails, and the surviving defenses, injuries, and immediate response are established.

okuto_wrong_destination.title: The Fight He Must Leave
okuto_wrong_destination.beats:
On day 405, Izuku Midoriya finds himself on Okuto Island's Coast Road instead of beside Shigaraki. Himiko Toga presses close while Ochaco Uraraka and Tsuyu Asui try to recover the assignment. Gang Orca's force is already fighting Moonfish and the island's other threats. If Izuku avoided the diversion, present the island team's corresponding containment problem without pulling him here afterward.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Toga describes becoming and hurting people she loves as part of the relationship she wants with Izuku. He cannot accept her proposal. Her sincere affection does not resemble ordinary hostile intent to his private danger warning, making her movements unexpectedly difficult to anticipate. Ochaco and Tsuyu recognize that keeping Izuku here endangers the entire plan. They take responsibility for Toga so that he can leave for the distant Academy battle.

Keep the conversation dangerous without treating rejection as proof that Toga cannot be reached. The player can create an exit, interrupt an attack, ask what Toga means, or insist on another allocation of defenders. Izuku's departure requires a real route over the water; Monoma is occupied with Erasure and cannot supply a fresh gate on demand. Until transport is established, island combat continues around the decision. Gang Orca's success against his opponents is not automatically settled by Izuku leaving.

By place: Okuto Island provides the direct confrontation and a threatened coastal departure. U.A. Academy receives the estimate of Izuku's arrival; Kamino Ward and Gunga Mountain Villa continue their separate battles. Musutafu General Hospital prepares for marine casualties, while Jaku City and Takoba Municipal Stadium exchange only the operational information they need. Mount Fuji Battlefield maintains ground warnings and future approach safety. Remote participants can help with navigation or reception without appearing on the island.

By Path: Class 1-A helps Ochaco and Tsuyu; Class 1-B reinforces containment; General Studies relays transport information. Support maintains marine equipment, Management verifies messages, and Faculty reallocates teams. Licensed Sidekick guards evacuation craft; Licensed Pro Hero engages the larger threats. League of Villains Recruit can assist Toga or oppose her isolation of Izuku; Independent Villain chooses an opening. Vigilante rescues stranded people; Civilian Life reaches protected transport.

The event is complete when Izuku has departed or been prevented from leaving, and the remaining island teams' responsibilities and departure route are explicit.

kamino_phosphor.title: Two Brothers' Fire
kamino_phosphor.beats:
Early in the day 405 fighting, Kamino Ward's Shopping Street burns around Shoto Todoroki and Dabi. Tenya Iida supports their position with Burnin, Kido, and Onima. Dabi wanted Endeavor; facing his younger brother gives him another target for the family's history. Nearby responders still have people and damaged streets to protect while the brothers speak.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Dabi describes surviving his childhood fire in a facility connected to All For One and returning to discover that Endeavor's destructive expectations had continued. This account reaches the people who can actually hear him, not every civilian watching the war. Shoto refuses to act merely as their father's substitute. He combines his own heat and cold through Phosphor, relying on the openings his allies create, and overwhelms Dabi's first offensive with a cooling attack.

Make one opening depend on the player's intervention: moving an injured sidekick, holding a firebreak, interrupting Dabi's line of attack, or helping Shoto reach the necessary distance. A conversation may alter the confrontation, but nobody owes immediate forgiveness. The apparent victory leaves Shoto exhausted and Dabi immobilized rather than safely dead. If nobody secures him, his observation of Phosphor remains a danger. A player who establishes effective custody or medical extraction can prevent his later return; do not undo that success.

By place: Kamino Ward stages the fire zone directly. U.A. Academy receives the initial containment report, while Okuto Island and Gunga Mountain Villa continue their own threats. Musutafu General Hospital prepares burn treatment; Jaku City and Takoba Municipal Stadium can relay supply or casualty requests. Mount Fuji Battlefield maintains perimeter warnings. Off-site participation concerns a reachable casualty, relief decision, or communication rather than an unexplained arrival beside Shoto.

By Path: Class 1-A supports Shoto and Iida; Class 1-B contains surrounding threats; General Studies relays casualties. Support supplies heat protection, Management maintains communications, and Faculty arranges relief. Licensed Sidekick protects the agency team; Licensed Pro Hero secures containment. League of Villains Recruit can aid Dabi or challenge his obsession; Independent Villain chooses an intervention. Vigilante searches damaged streets; Civilian Life evacuates or helps someone unable to move.

The event is complete when Dabi's first offensive stops or breaks containment, and the brothers' condition, sidekick casualties, and actual custody are explicitly reported.

gunga_break_the_mask.title: The Extras Fight Back
gunga_break_the_mask.beats:
During the early battle on day 405, Endeavor and Hawks confront Shigaraki's Sensei on Gunga Mountain Villa's ruined grounds. All For One uses Toya's history to distract Endeavor and creates an opening against the leading heroes. Kyoka Jiro and Fumikage Tokoyami approach a fight their opponent assumes they are too insignificant to influence.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Jiro and Tokoyami intervene to protect Hawks and disrupt All For One's control of the engagement. Jiro's defiance helps stir resistance among his stolen Quirks, a struggle other observers cannot fully perceive. Coordinated attacks break his life-support mask. Endeavor fights through the loss of his right arm and burns the enemy's body, while Jiro loses her left earjack. All For One survives the assault and is driven toward a concealed last resort.

Stage the mask attack through a threatened approach and a limited chance to combine attacks. The player can shield Jiro, stabilize Endeavor, obstruct a counterattack, or defend All For One. Prevented injuries remain prevented. If catastrophic wounds occur, supply immediate field stabilization and a named handoff for extraction to Musutafu General Hospital; remaining in combat must carry the cost and cannot become instant recovery. Hawks and Tokoyami retain their Quirks at this point. Breaking the mask is a tactical success, not proof that All For One has died.

By place: Gunga Mountain Villa provides the direct engagement. U.A. Academy, Okuto Island, and Kamino Ward receive only the reports their teams can exchange. Musutafu General Hospital prepares emergency treatment; Jaku City and Takoba Municipal Stadium manage requests without abandoning their assignments. Mount Fuji Battlefield clears threatened approaches. A distant player can secure supplies, rescue access, or accurate reporting while the assault resolves elsewhere.

By Path: Class 1-A assists Jiro or Tokoyami; Class 1-B checks supporting threats; General Studies relays medical needs. Support sustains protection, Management prioritizes messages, and Faculty coordinates relief. Licensed Sidekick extracts wounded; Licensed Pro Hero joins the attack. League of Villains Recruit can defend All For One or reconsider loyalty; Independent Villain exploits or contests the opening. Vigilante searches the perimeter; Civilian Life keeps evacuation routes clear.

The event is complete when the mask assault resolves and All For One's actual condition, the heroes' injuries, and immediate treatment arrangements are established.

bakugo_heart_stops.title: A Victory That Has Not Come
bakugo_heart_stops.beats:
By the middle fighting on day 405, the floating U.A. Academy arena is battered and Izuku Midoriya is still approaching unless earlier intervention brought him sooner. Katsuki Bakugo prepares a major attack while Best Jeanist, Mirko, Edgeshot, Mirio Togata, Tamaki Amajiki, and Nejire Hado struggle to hold Tomura Shigaraki. Use the enclosure's surviving systems and the injuries already established.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Bakugo's attack fails to secure victory, and Shigaraki crushes his right arm. The Big Three combine their abilities to protect the defenders and attempt a decisive strike, but the enemy continues advancing. Bakugo's evolving Cluster produces extraordinary speed at a terrible bodily cost. Shigaraki catches him and strikes his chest, rupturing his heart and leaving him in cardiac arrest. Best Jeanist responds immediately, and Edgeshot commits his own body to internal repair while the others keep the attacker away.

Keep Bakugo reachable before the chest strike. The player can alter its line, extract him, shield another defender, or protect the subsequent resuscitation. Cardiac arrest does not remove him as a confirmed death. If the strike lands, no conversation or ordinary healing casually returns him to combat. Mirko's continuing resistance costs further limbs and prosthetic damage unless prevented; describe the tactical consequences without dwelling on gore. Hospital evacuation requires a secured route, so stabilization and protection must happen here until such a route exists.

By place: U.A. Academy stages either the rescue pocket or its threatened maintenance access. Okuto Island, Kamino Ward, and Gunga Mountain Villa receive restricted casualty requests. Musutafu General Hospital prepares critical care; Jaku City and Takoba Municipal Stadium can provide a reachable supply or communication response. Mount Fuji Battlefield supports ground rescue and falling-debris precautions. A remote player cannot directly operate on Bakugo.

By Path: Class 1-A protects its classmate; Class 1-B reinforces the enclosure; General Studies moves medical supplies. Support replaces machinery, Management tracks shortages, and Faculty chooses rescue priorities. Licensed Sidekick shields Edgeshot; Licensed Pro Hero holds Shigaraki. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain can exploit or interrupt the rescue crisis. Vigilante handles ground casualties; Civilian Life assists emergency reception.

The event is complete when Bakugo's actual condition and the resuscitation attempt's protection, disruption, or unnecessary prevention are explicitly established.

deku_reaches_the_coffin.title: Control Your Heart
deku_reaches_the_coffin.beats:
During the middle phase of day 405, Izuku Midoriya reaches the floating U.A. Academy battlefield with help along his approach from the American pilots. The arena is damaged, its defenders wounded, and Katsuki Bakugo lies under treatment in the default course. Mirio Togata remains between Tomura Shigaraki and the people still trying to save him. An earlier arrival or prevented injury changes what Izuku finds.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the enemy draws Izuku's attention to Bakugo and tries to turn grief and rage into an uncontrolled attack. Mirio makes clear that the rescue effort has not been abandoned. Izuku regains enough control to fight deliberately, combines his inherited abilities, and uses the second holder's Gearshift to overwhelm the enemy temporarily. The acceleration carries a strict useful window and dangerous physical backlash. An extraordinary opening does not establish Shigaraki's defeat.

Give the player a concrete role in the arrival: securing a landing space, protecting Mirio's attempt to reach Izuku, shielding treatment, or disrupting the first combination. Let a credible intervention change Izuku's immediate judgment. The private voices advising him remain inaccessible to ordinary witnesses.
