Once Gearshift is spent, its effects and approaching exhaustion remain part of the next confrontations; neither a new scene nor a supportive speech restores his body. Bakugo stays under treatment unless his earlier condition actually differs.

By place: U.A. Academy provides the arrival and direct engagement. Okuto Island can confirm the route Izuku left behind; Kamino Ward and Gunga Mountain Villa receive the revised battle status. Musutafu General Hospital prepares for continuing critical injuries. Jaku City and Takoba Municipal Stadium remain responsible for their own containment, while Mount Fuji Battlefield supports the ground approach and debris warnings. Remote players can verify assistance or protect an accessible casualty.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B create a safe opening; General Studies coordinates incoming aid; Support manages arena damage. Management transmits accurate status and Faculty protects containment. Licensed Sidekick shields the wounded; Licensed Pro Hero supports Izuku's attack. League of Villains Recruit can aid Shigaraki's survival; Independent Villain chooses a tactical intervention. Vigilante protects approach zones; Civilian Life assists rescuers below the battlefield.

The event is complete when Izuku takes over the direct engagement or his arrival is blocked, and the resulting advantage, injuries, and remaining time are established.

central_hospital_uprising.title: Whose Anger Is This?
central_hospital_uprising.beats:
During day 405's concurrent middle fighting, a mass assault reaches Musutafu General Hospital. Spinner leads attackers seeking Kurogiri while police, staff, Mezo Shoji, Koji Koda, and Present Mic protect a functioning hospital. Patients cannot simply be abandoned because a detainee is the target. Distinguish people expressing anger over discrimination from those actively attacking the wards.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Shoji confronts a crowd whose experiences of prejudice resemble his own. His exposed scars and account of his past challenge the claim that assaulting patients will protect heteromorphs. Koda's growing ability helps disrupt the attackers and their leadership. Many participants stop advancing when confronted with the hospital staff's defense of their patients. Spinner, physically enhanced and increasingly overwhelmed, nevertheless reaches Kurogiri. His connection to Tomura Shigaraki succeeds in awakening the warp-gate villain.

Stage one contested approach and one opportunity to turn people away from violence. The player can protect patients, challenge an organizer, help Spinner, or separate withdrawing participants from those still attacking. Stopping the crowd does not automatically stop Spinner inside. Kurogiri remains reachable while dormant, and securing or moving him earlier can prevent the default awakening. If awakened, establish that result without already resolving the later portal cascade. Spinner survives incapacitated and requires treatment under guard.

By place: Musutafu General Hospital provides the ward defense and secured patient room. U.A. Academy receives warnings about its vulnerable reliance on containment; Okuto Island, Kamino Ward, and Gunga Mountain Villa receive only verified developments. Jaku City and Takoba Municipal Stadium can help with reachable medical or communication duties. Mount Fuji Battlefield maintains evacuation access. Remote participants support a specific patient transfer, crowd message, or request rather than directing unseen people omnisciently.

By Path: Class 1-A supports Shoji and Koda; Class 1-B defends approaches; General Studies assists patient movement. Support preserves emergency systems, Management separates verified facts from inflammatory rumor, and Faculty protects students and patients. Licensed Sidekick guards wards; Licensed Pro Hero directs containment. League of Villains Recruit can assist Spinner or reject hospital violence; Independent Villain influences the attackers. Vigilante shields patients; Civilian Life challenges the crowd or helps evacuation.

The event is complete when the assault's outcome, Kurogiri's dormant or awakened state, and the safety and custody of patients and detainees are established.

jaku_machia_custody.title: Acid Against the Past
jaku_machia_custody.beats:
On day 405, before any reinforcement from Gigantomachia reaches Gunga, villains attack his custody position in Jaku City's Residential Hills. Mina Ashido, Eijiro Kirishima, Hitoshi Shinso, Mount Lady, and the assigned defenders confront the attempted liberation. Among the attackers is the fighter responsible for Nemuri Kayama's death. That association is learned through the confrontation, not supplied to every distant observer.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Mina recognizes the fear bound to her earlier encounter with Gigantomachia and refuses to let it decide who she can save now. Her stronger acid protects allies and breaks the attackers' advantage, leaving her dangerously exhausted. Kirishima supports her rather than allowing the effort to become another solitary sacrifice. Shinso uses his voice equipment and Brainwashing to bring Gigantomachia under the heroes' direction. The group turns the attempted liberation into a route toward reinforcing Gunga.

Give the player a threatened custody barrier, a chance to protect Shinso's equipment, or a casualty who needs removal while Mina acts. Gigantomachia is not an obedient vehicle merely because a hero wants to ride him; establish the successful exchange and control. His departure requires a chosen route and warnings to settlements along it. Mina's exhaustion needs actual treatment, with serious deterioration prompting extraction to Musutafu General Hospital. The defeated attackers remain a custody responsibility after the mobile team leaves.

By place: Jaku City stages the attack and departure. Gunga Mountain Villa receives the warning and arrival estimate, without receiving the reinforcement early. U.A. Academy, Okuto Island, and Kamino Ward exchange relevant deployment messages. Musutafu General Hospital receives casualties; Takoba Municipal Stadium maintains its own containment. Mount Fuji Battlefield can protect threatened approaches and relay route warnings. An off-site player can secure a reachable segment of the journey rather than instantly joining the riders.

By Path: Class 1-A supports Mina and Kirishima; Class 1-B protects custody; General Studies assists Shinso. Support safeguards voice equipment, Management coordinates route warnings, and Faculty authorizes the counterattack. Licensed Sidekick holds the perimeter; Licensed Pro Hero directs movement. League of Villains Recruit attempts liberation or changes sides; Independent Villain chooses control or escape. Vigilante protects nearby residents; Civilian Life evacuates the announced route.

The event is complete when Gigantomachia's actual control and destination, Mina's care, and the remaining defenders' and prisoners' disposition are established.

warp_gates_and_twice.title: The Battlefields Break Open
warp_gates_and_twice.beats:
During day 405's middle crisis, Kurogiri's awakening threatens the separation holding the battle plan together. Mist appears at connected fronts while defenders try to identify each opening before someone crosses it. Begin from the actual hospital outcome: if Kurogiri remains secured, the player instead confronts the attempted connection and the enemy's failure to obtain the expected route.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Dabi revives from his initial defeat by imitating Phosphor and passes from Kamino to Gunga to reach Endeavor. Himiko Toga uses Twice's stored blood to transform and sends multiplying doubles through Kurogiri's connections. Ochaco Uraraka and Tsuyu Asui pursue the threat from Okuto. Doubles reach the floating Academy's observers, interrupt Monoma's Erasure, and expose the defenders to Shigaraki's restored Quirks. Shota Aizawa and Present Mic become cut off amid the portal disruption.

Stage one gate mouth at the player's actual front. Its destination must be established before passage; entering mist does not grant unrestricted choice of location. A barricade, a warning, an intercepted double, or a conversation with Kurogiri can change who crosses. Dabi cannot revive here if earlier custody genuinely prevented it. Toga needs the blood and the opportunity to use it, and her transformation has a running limit. Twice himself remains dead. Establish actual clone concentrations without treating a double of any person as proof that the original has arrived.

By place: Musutafu General Hospital contains Kurogiri's point of activation; Okuto Island faces Toga's departure; Kamino Ward faces Dabi's escape; Gunga Mountain Villa receives their default arrivals. U.A. Academy faces the attack on Erasure. Jaku City and Takoba Municipal Stadium verify any threatened connections while protecting their own teams. Mount Fuji Battlefield receives warnings about displaced threats and unsafe approaches. Remote players can identify a breached route or protect a reachable arrival point.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B defend gate exits; General Studies tracks displaced teams; Support isolates breached systems. Management reconciles reports and Faculty restores command. Licensed Sidekick protects exposed personnel; Licensed Pro Hero contains arrivals. League of Villains Recruit exploits or contests the gates; Independent Villain chooses passage or withdrawal. Vigilante rescues displaced people; Civilian Life avoids breached evacuation routes.

The event is complete when the portal cascade's actual destinations, Erasure's condition, displaced personnel, and immediate losses are established.

save_the_falling_academy.title: Help From Former Enemies
save_the_falling_academy.beats:
Immediately after the default breach on day 405, the floating U.A. Academy is falling toward catastrophe. Damaged systems and Tomoyasu Chikazoku's intrusion threaten everyone still aboard and below. Izuku Midoriya must keep Shigaraki from reaching a destructive contact while maintenance crews try to preserve the structure. If the breach was prevented, stage the remaining sabotage and structural threat at its actual severity.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: La Brava counters Skeptic's intrusion and helps the pursuing heroes locate him. Gentle Criminal uses his elasticity beneath the falling Academy, supported by La Brava's love, to hold a disaster away from the people below. From Musutafu General Hospital, the severely wounded Lady Nagant fires shots that interrupt Shigaraki's attempts to use his hands. These interventions buy Izuku the chance to draw the engagement away from the endangered structure and toward the ground.

Let the player rescue a trapped compartment, preserve a working control, relay a clear firing opportunity, or oppose the rescuers. Gentle's intervention buys support rather than restoring destroyed machinery. Nagant's determination does not heal her wounds; her firing position must remain reachable for medical assistance, and she returns to guarded treatment afterward. Skeptic's capture follows an actual interception once his location is exposed. A repair of the computer network alone does not save everyone trapped in damaged sections.

By place: U.A. Academy stages the falling compartments and Gentle's intervention; Musutafu General Hospital stages Nagant's guarded rooftop position. Mount Fuji Battlefield receives Izuku and Shigaraki only after their groundward movement is established. Okuto Island, Kamino Ward, and Gunga Mountain Villa receive warnings through available communications. Jaku City and Takoba Municipal Stadium can supply reachable rescue support without abandoning unresolved battles. Keep La Brava's remote assistance distinct from physical presence aboard the Academy.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B stabilize compartments; General Studies moves trapped personnel; Support restores controls. Management routes verified data and Faculty directs evacuation. Licensed Sidekick shields technicians; Licensed Pro Hero supports the ground engagement or capture. League of Villains Recruit can defend the intrusion; Independent Villain bargains over access. Vigilante assists Gentle's rescue; Civilian Life evacuates the impact zone.

The event is complete when the immediate fall is stopped or its actual impact resolves, and the surviving structure, hacker, rescuers, and ground combatants have established dispositions.

gunga_last_reinforcements.title: Everyone Against All For One
gunga_last_reinforcements.beats:
Later in day 405's middle fighting, Shigaraki's Sensei stands restored on Gunga Mountain Villa's ruined grounds and begins growing younger. Hawks and Fumikage Tokoyami face him as the remaining coalition gathers. Inasa Yoarashi, Camie Utsushimi, and Seiji Shishikura reinforce the front; the Jaku group arrives only if its earlier departure succeeded.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: All For One has used a drug derived from Rewind that restores his body while carrying him toward eventual erasure. Shiketsu's coordinated support, Tokoyami's enormous Dark Shadow, and the attacks of Mount Lady and Gigantomachia delay him. Machia's response includes his own anger at abandonment, not merely obedience to Shinso. All For One ultimately devastates the coalition, steals Hawks's Fierce Wings, and leaves toward Shigaraki. Minoru Mineta's defiance helps distract him from taking Dark Shadow, which remains Tokoyami's.

Choose an opening within the combined assault or the following rescue crisis. The player can extend the delay, shield Hawks from contact, protect Shinso, or help All For One escape. A prevented Quirk theft remains prevented. Machia is struck down in the default course, but collapse does not establish a precise death; leave him reachable for assessment. Severe casualties require field stabilization and transport to Musutafu General Hospital when extraction is secured. The enemy's rejuvenation is not an ordinary recovery that can continue indefinitely.

By place: Gunga Mountain Villa provides the coalition attack and casualty field. Jaku City verifies the arriving group's route. U.A. Academy, Okuto Island, and Kamino Ward receive a warning when All For One departs. Musutafu General Hospital prepares major casualty reception; Takoba Municipal Stadium keeps its own force engaged. Mount Fuji Battlefield receives the warning of an approaching enemy, not his automatic arrival. A distant player can protect an actual evacuation or interception route.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B coordinate attacks or extraction; General Studies supports Shinso's communications. Support sustains damaged gear, Management requests reserves, and Faculty organizes retreat. Licensed Sidekick extracts fallen fighters; Licensed Pro Hero delays All For One. League of Villains Recruit chooses between him, Machia, or defection; Independent Villain contests the departure. Vigilante rescues the fallen; Civilian Life clears medical routes.

The event is complete when All For One's departure or containment, the coalition's losses, and the actual status of Hawks, Dark Shadow, and Gigantomachia are established.

evacuation_routes_under_attack.title: Keep the Shelters Moving
evacuation_routes_under_attack.beats:
During day 405, evacuation personnel discover that moving shelters and protected routes are vulnerable to sabotage, infiltrators, and changing surface threats. Open with the player's reachable group at a staffed access point, a stalled transport section, or a receiving area. Near Gunga, Rei Todoroki, Fuyumi Todoroki, and Natsuo Todoroki face news that Toya's battle is approaching the people being evacuated.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Skeptic's interference and embedded sympathizers expose weaknesses in the evacuation operation. Defenders and civilians keep routes functioning while the danger around Gunga grows. Countering the intrusion helps, but physical obstructions, frightened passengers, and compromised exits still need attention. The Todoroki relatives move toward the confrontation with Toya instead of remaining distant observers, setting up their arrival before the threatened explosion is resolved.

Give the party one group with a real headcount, a destination, and a choice between routes. The player can expose an infiltrator, repair an access mechanism, escort a vulnerable passenger, or protect people from an accusation made without evidence. Do not identify guilt from appearance. If the family chooses to approach Toya, make their route and the opportunity to stop or accompany them explicit. Preventing that journey changes the next confrontation. A successful computer repair does not move a single passenger until transport or an escort actually works.

By place: U.A. Academy handles shelter access and transport coordination; Gunga Mountain Villa supplies the threatened surface exits. Musutafu General Hospital receives injured evacuees. Okuto Island uses marine transport, Kamino Ward clears damaged streets, Jaku City warns residents along the giant's route, and Takoba Municipal Stadium maintains a protected reception point. Mount Fuji Battlefield protects the remaining approaches from spreading destruction. Stage only the section physically reachable from the player's present front.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B escort assigned groups; General Studies reconciles headcounts; Support restores doors and transport. Management provides accurate route instructions and Faculty chooses alternatives. Licensed Sidekick investigates suspected sabotage; Licensed Pro Hero defends exits. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain can aid sabotage, abandon it, or protect the stranded. Vigilante guides surface rescues; Civilian Life organizes fellow evacuees and challenges dangerous confusion.

The event is complete when the player's refugee group reaches a stated safe place or receives an explicit rescue handover, and the Todoroki relatives' actual route is established.

todoroki_family_stops_dabi.title: The Whole Family Arrives
todoroki_family_stops_dabi.beats:
Late in the day 405 battle, Dabi's accumulated heat threatens a devastating explosion at Gunga Mountain Villa. Endeavor, already missing his right arm in the default course, attempts to carry Toya away from the evacuation area. Rei, Fuyumi, and Natsuo arrive through their established route. Shoto Todoroki is still at Kamino with Tenya Iida until their journey actually begins.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Endeavor tries to take the catastrophe upon himself, but the other family members refuse to remain outside Toya's suffering. Their ice helps contain the heat while burning them in turn. Iida carries the exhausted Shoto from Kamino at extraordinary speed, aided by Shoto's cooling. Shoto reaches the confrontation and uses a massive cooling attack with his family's support. The explosion is prevented, and Toya survives in a terminally injured condition requiring guarded life support.

Make the threatened evacuation area and the remaining approach concrete. The player can clear Iida's route, support cooling, extract a family member, or attempt to reach Dabi before the heat peaks. Dabi remains reachable while alive; a credible intervention may improve his survival rather than merely postpone death. Earlier secure custody can replace the blast crisis with the consequences of having prevented it. Nobody is required to forgive Endeavor, and surviving together does not establish reconciliation. Severe burns and Endeavor's additional injuries require actual transfer to Musutafu General Hospital.

By place: Gunga Mountain Villa stages the cooling effort and extraction; Kamino Ward stages Shoto and Iida's departure. U.A. Academy and Okuto Island receive blast warnings through available communications. Musutafu General Hospital prepares guarded critical care and family treatment. Jaku City and Takoba Municipal Stadium support reachable evacuation or supply work. Mount Fuji Battlefield keeps threatened approaches clear. Remote players act on the warning locally rather than arriving ahead of a journey never made.

By Path: Class 1-A supports Shoto's route or cooling; Class 1-B protects the perimeter; General Studies locates evacuees. Support supplies thermal protection, Management distributes blast warnings, and Faculty directs rescue. Licensed Sidekick extracts relatives; Licensed Pro Hero contains heat. League of Villains Recruit can aid Dabi or oppose his self-destruction; Independent Villain chooses an intervention. Vigilante clears endangered routes; Civilian Life evacuates or assists accessible rescue logistics.

The event is complete when the explosion is prevented or resolves, and the family's actual survival, treatment, Dabi's custody, and the surrounding evacuation outcome are established.

ochaco_reaches_toga.title: A Smile Worth Seeing
ochaco_reaches_toga.beats:
Late on day 405, Gunga Mountain Villa's slopes disappear beneath multiplying doubles while Ochaco Uraraka tries to reach Himiko Toga. Tsuyu Asui and the surrounding defenders struggle to keep people from being overwhelmed. If the earlier portals or blood transformation were prevented, begin from Toga's actual position and the smaller confrontation that remains.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Toga stabs Ochaco, leaving a life-threatening wound, but Ochaco continues trying to understand her instead of reducing her to the swarm. Ochaco's awakened Zero Gravity spreads through the doubles, lifting the mass and interrupting its assault. Her willingness to offer Toga blood answers the need for acceptance beneath Toga's violence without excusing the people she has hurt. As the transformation expires, Toga chooses to give her own blood to Ochaco. Without another rescue, that transfusion saves Ochaco and costs Toga her life.

Keep both women physically reachable before death is established. The player can prevent the stabbing, clear a medical approach, provide compatible emergency support, or persuade Toga to accept a rescue that saves both. Her death is the canon default, not a price the scene demands. Do not complete it merely because she begins transfusing. Establish the actual result through medical assessment and preserve any successful intervention. Twice remains dead; the doubles vanish with the relevant transformation and do not become revived originals. The intimate exchange is not automatically carried by the battlefield cameras.

By place: Gunga Mountain Villa stages the approach through the swarm and the medical rescue. Musutafu General Hospital prepares urgent blood-loss treatment. U.A. Academy, Okuto Island, and Kamino Ward receive reports that distinguish the swarm's disappearance from a confirmed casualty. Jaku City and Takoba Municipal Stadium assist reachable requests while their teams remain accountable. Mount Fuji Battlefield protects approaches from remaining displaced threats. Remote players can arrange aid without hearing the private conversation.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B protect access or contain doubles; General Studies coordinates medics; Support supplies emergency equipment. Management checks witnesses and Faculty organizes treatment. Licensed Sidekick extracts wounded; Licensed Pro Hero contains the swarm. League of Villains Recruit can support Toga or seek a rescue for both women; Independent Villain intervenes or withdraws. Vigilante reaches trapped casualties; Civilian Life supplies accessible emergency assistance.

The event is complete when the clone threat has ended and Toga's and Ochaco's actual medical outcomes, including any prevented death, are explicitly established.

troy_kunieda_bloom.title: Aoyama Holds His Ground
troy_kunieda_bloom.beats:
Late on day 405, the team left at Troy's ground deployment perimeter faces Kunieda's spreading plants. Yuga Aoyama and Toru Hagakure remain with Fat Gum and the trapped defenders while the Academy's airborne battle develops elsewhere. Keep the ground detachment distinct from the people maintaining the floating arena; sharing a command does not put everyone in the same fight.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Kunieda's growth immobilizes Fat Gum and other heroes and feeds on their bodies. He mocks the trust that allowed Aoyama to stand with the heroes. Aoyama refuses to abandon that decision and fires despite the disadvantage. Hagakure refracts his laser into an attack that defeats Kunieda. Winning the exchange leaves living people entangled in dangerous plants, so the rescue continues after the villain stops fighting.

Give the player a captive who can still be reached, a threatened line of fire, or an extraction tool that must be brought through the growth. Removing a visible vine does not necessarily remove the growth threatening someone internally. Aoyama's cooperation is now demonstrated by his actions; his earlier deal and its full circumstances do not become universal knowledge merely because he fights. Hagakure's momentary visibility is a situational effect of the light, not a permanent loss of invisibility. Keep any resulting embarrassment brief and allow clothing and privacy without sexualized attention.

By place: U.A. Academy's ground staging access provides the Troy detachment's fight and rescue. Musutafu General Hospital receives injured captives once they are genuinely released. Okuto Island, Kamino Ward, and Gunga Mountain Villa receive the request for extraction help. Jaku City and Takoba Municipal Stadium can relay supplies or medical information while retaining their own duties. Mount Fuji Battlefield receives only fighters who are actually freed and transported. Remote players can arrange a receiving team or missing-person check rather than firing the decisive attack from afar.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B clear plants or free allies; General Studies identifies missing teammates; Support supplies extraction tools. Management requests treatment and Faculty coordinates rescue. Licensed Sidekick removes accessible growth; Licensed Pro Hero contains Kunieda. League of Villains Recruit can support the remaining villains or surrender; Independent Villain bargains over escape. Vigilante reaches trapped defenders; Civilian Life supports the medical receiving point.

The event is complete when Kunieda cannot continue and every trapped person in the player's rescue area is freed or explicitly handed over for continuing extraction.

takoba_gashly_front.title: The Fight Beyond the Cameras
takoba_gashly_front.beats:
On day 405, the force at Takoba Municipal Stadium is still fighting while the better-publicized fronts dominate communications. Hanta Sero, Mashirao Ojiro, Rikido Sato, Ryukyu, and their associated defenders confront Gashly Eijiju across the Exam Arena and its damaged approaches. Open with a local position under pressure rather than assuming this team has been free to reinforce someone else.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Gashly's manifested threats keep the team committed to a sustained containment battle. The defenders prevent him from overrunning their position and eventually stop his resistance, allowing survivors to become available for the later convergence. The immediate work is coordinated fighting, protecting casualties, and denying the escapee another opening. His small manifested figures are artificial puppets, not real children, and fighting them never authorizes harm to an actual child.

Build the playable encounter around a threatened lane, a trapped teammate, or a shortage that has gone unanswered. Use the defenders' established abilities for a concrete plan: Sero's tethers, Ojiro's controlled close fighting, Sato's limited strength bursts, and Ryukyu's protection. Do not supply an elaborate unseen canonical finishing technique for Gashly. The player's tactics can determine how the containment ends and who remains fit to travel. Success here does not require a claim that suffering gave the defenders' lives meaning; their ordinary bonds and effort already matter.

By place: Takoba Municipal Stadium stages the direct fight and relief. Musutafu General Hospital receives casualties once extraction is secured. U.A. Academy, Okuto Island, Kamino Ward, and Gunga Mountain Villa receive an accurate availability report instead of premature reinforcements. Jaku City can coordinate reachable supplies. Mount Fuji Battlefield receives this team only after its local threat ends and a route or gate is actually available. Off-site participation concerns relief, reception, or verified communication.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B reinforce containment; General Studies relays stalled requests; Support maintains equipment. Management finds neglected supplies and Faculty arranges relief. Licensed Sidekick extracts casualties; Licensed Pro Hero directs the containment. League of Villains Recruit can aid Gashly or abandon him; Independent Villain chooses resistance, surrender, or escape. Vigilante protects nearby approaches; Civilian Life sustains the medical station and helps people reach shelter.

The event is complete when Gashly's local threat is resolved, custody and injuries are established, and the surviving team's availability for its next assignment is explicit.

armored_all_might.title: I Am Here
armored_all_might.beats:
Late on day 405, All Might intercepts Shigaraki's Sensei along the route toward Shigaraki, on the approaches through Kamino Ward. He is visibly the retired, frail teacher the country now knows. Support armor unfolds around him with assistance from Hercules. Stain watches for an opening nearby. If All For One never escaped Gunga, relocate the interception only through an established journey or resolve the delay that has already succeeded.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: All Might uses armor functions inspired by his students to turn the enemy's hatred into wasted time. All For One keeps attacking him instead of proceeding directly to Shigaraki, while Rewind continues making the original body younger. Armor and vehicle components are progressively destroyed. Stain intervenes with Bloodcurdle, but All For One counters him and kills him unless someone changes that exchange. All Might survives the armored fight severely injured, captured, and facing a publicly visible execution.

Keep Stain reachable before the counterattack, with an opportunity to shield him, force separation, or secure emergency extraction. His death is a default consequence, not an announcement at the opening. All Might's equipment has finite functions and does not give him his old Quirk back. The player can preserve a component, create an escape route, interfere with the broadcast, or help the enemy close the trap. Once a component is destroyed, later scenes cannot reuse it. All Might's capture must establish his actual condition and the execution threat without completing his death.

By place: Kamino Ward provides the interception and rescue approaches. U.A. Academy receives the broadcast while its wounded defenders remain occupied. Okuto Island, Gunga Mountain Villa, Jaku City, and Takoba Municipal Stadium respond from their actual remaining duties. Musutafu General Hospital prepares critical reception. Mount Fuji Battlefield receives the warning that All For One is still trying to reach Shigaraki. Remote players can coordinate a rescue request or protect local casualties without arriving through the screen.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B respond from their fronts; General Studies relays requests; Support assesses armor failures. Management maintains communications and Faculty seeks a rescue opening. Licensed Sidekick clears an approach; Licensed Pro Hero intercepts. League of Villains Recruit can aid or undermine the execution; Independent Villain exploits or contests it. Vigilante approaches rescue positions; Civilian Life helps nearby wounded.

The event is complete when the delaying action ends and All Might's condition and captivity, Stain's actual fate, and the remaining rescue opening are established.

bakugo_saves_all_might.title: The Hand That Reaches Back
bakugo_saves_all_might.beats:
Immediately after the armored engagement on day 405, All Might faces execution in All For One's grasp. At U.A. Academy, Katsuki Bakugo's repair reaches a decisive moment while Best Jeanist protects him. Izuku Midoriya remains responsible for Shigaraki at the ground battle. If All Might was already freed or Bakugo's condition changed, use the rescue still needed rather than recreating the default injuries.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Edgeshot's internal repair has restored the damaged structures, while Bakugo's evolving explosions supply the final stimulus that allows his heart to function again. Edgeshot survives in an extremely diminished state. Bakugo rises with severe injuries still present and recognizes the chance to reach All Might. Izuku understands his intention and uses Gearshift to accelerate the rescue. Bakugo crosses the remaining distance and tears All Might free before the execution can be completed.

Give the player a concrete opening around the rescue: a clear launch path, protection for Edgeshot, a distraction at the captor's position, or a safe receiving point. Bakugo's renewed movement is not full recovery; his damaged heart and right arm remain serious liabilities. A player can secure another rescue if he cannot rise. Once All Might is free, assign an actual escort and treatment destination rather than leaving him standing beside the duel. Izuku cannot abandon Shigaraki without exposing everyone around the ground engagement.

By place: U.A. Academy stages Bakugo's return to consciousness and departure; Kamino Ward stages the interception of All Might's execution. Mount Fuji Battlefield provides Izuku's support only across the established line of action. Musutafu General Hospital prepares for All Might and Edgeshot. Okuto Island, Gunga Mountain Villa, Jaku City, and Takoba Municipal Stadium can answer local extraction or communication needs. A broadcast allows coordination, not physical intervention from an unconnected front.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B protect the rescue opening; General Studies prepares reception; Support identifies surviving equipment. Management relays extraction signals and Faculty coordinates cover. Licensed Sidekick receives All Might; Licensed Pro Hero obstructs All For One. League of Villains Recruit can prevent or allow the rescue; Independent Villain chooses an intervention. Vigilante assists extraction; Civilian Life opens a route for medics and shelters nearby casualties.

The event is complete when All Might is free or the rescue attempt has otherwise resolved, and his escort, Bakugo's actual condition, and Edgeshot's survival are established.

bakugo_ends_original_afo.title: The Demon Lord Runs Out of Time
bakugo_ends_original_afo.beats:
Late on day 405, Katsuki Bakugo confronts the original body of Shigaraki's Sensei along the damaged route through Kamino Ward. All Might has an escort in the default course, but All For One still intends to reach Shigaraki. Bakugo's right arm and recently repaired heart remain severely compromised. Rewind is visibly reducing his opponent's age and remaining time.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Bakugo's awakened explosions let him pursue and redirect an opponent who expects to overpower him. He keeps All For One from reaching the body he wants to control. Under pressure, the enemy's private memories expose his possessiveness toward Yoichi and the origin of their conflict; these memories are not part of the public broadcast. Repeated setbacks consume the original body's remaining Rewind time until it disappears entirely. Bakugo collapses with injuries that still require urgent treatment.

Stage one threatened escape lane and one chance to protect people in the pursuit corridor. The player can help Bakugo deny the route, shield him from a counterattack, aid the fleeing enemy, or pursue a credible containment alternative. All For One remains physically reachable until his disappearance is established. The apparent youth of the rewinding body does not make it a newly introduced child civilian. If the original body survives through an intervention, preserve the resulting danger rather than announcing erasure anyway. Its destruction does not remove the separate remaining presence inside Shigaraki.

By place: Kamino Ward stages the pursuit and Bakugo's collapse. Mount Fuji Battlefield receives a warning or confirmation concerning the original body's approach. U.A. Academy monitors Bakugo's condition; Musutafu General Hospital prepares critical reception once extraction becomes possible. Okuto Island, Gunga Mountain Villa, Jaku City, and Takoba Municipal Stadium protect local people and relay verified updates. Remote participants can secure an actual escape corridor or medical approach without joining the duel through a screen.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B protect casualties or assist pursuit; General Studies tracks the route; Support sustains damaged gear. Management warns districts and Faculty coordinates interception. Licensed Sidekick extracts bystanders; Licensed Pro Hero blocks an escape lane. League of Villains Recruit helps All For One or abandons him; Independent Villain exploits or contests his defeat. Vigilante protects the corridor; Civilian Life shelters and helps reachable wounded.

The event is complete when the original body's actual fate is established and Bakugo's collapse, protection, and urgent medical handoff are acknowledged.

deku_gives_up_one_for_all.title: Break the Wound Open
deku_gives_up_one_for_all.beats:
In day 405's final engagement, Izuku Midoriya and Tomura Shigaraki fight across Mount Fuji Battlefield's Lava Plain. Shigaraki steals Danger Sense and continues threatening destruction far beyond the immediate combat area. Izuku's body is already damaged by the preceding fights and Gearshift's cost. Ordinary observers see his movements and injuries, not the discussions occurring among the vestiges.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Izuku uses Blackwhip through and around his body to keep moving in an Overlay form. Privately, Kudo proposes forcing the inherited power into the spiritual wound left by Star and Stripe's resistance. Izuku accepts a transfer assault that sacrifices the inheritance in order to reach the suffering person within Shigaraki. The attack proceeds through successive contacts rather than a single consequence-free decision. Danger Sense is no longer available to Izuku, and transferred abilities cease to be his resources.

At each successful contact, state privately which power has actually passed and which still sustains him. Do not remove an ability before its transfer or restore one afterward. The player can protect an approach, prevent collateral deaths, interrupt a transfer, support Shigaraki, or help create a different way to reach him. Learning the private plan requires an established means of contact and an actual disclosure. A camera cannot explain why Izuku chooses a particular strike. His desire to save Tenko remains a dangerous attempt rather than proof that survival is guaranteed.

By place: Mount Fuji Battlefield provides the direct fight and threatened perimeter. U.A. Academy supplies verified support information; Musutafu General Hospital prepares stabilization and casualty reception. Okuto Island, Kamino Ward, Gunga Mountain Villa, Jaku City, and Takoba Municipal Stadium handle their surviving responsibilities and any genuinely available reinforcement routes. Remote participants can clear an evacuation path or prepare help without entering the vestige encounter or immediately appearing beside Izuku.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B protect approaches; General Studies relays terrain and medical reports; Support assesses surviving equipment. Management maintains accurate broadcasts and Faculty prepares reinforcement. Licensed Sidekick extracts exposed people; Licensed Pro Hero limits collateral destruction. League of Villains Recruit can support Shigaraki or reject All For One; Independent Villain chooses an intervention. Vigilante rescues at the margins; Civilian Life evacuates and supports responders.

The event is complete when the transfer assault reaches or fails to reach Shigaraki's inner defenses, and Izuku's actually lost abilities, remaining support, and physical condition are explicit.

tenko_and_the_stolen_life.title: The Child Inside
tenko_and_the_stolen_life.beats:
Immediately after the transfer assault on day 405, Izuku Midoriya reaches the memories behind Tomura Shigaraki's hatred. Their bodies remain at Mount Fuji Battlefield while the encounter unfolds inwardly. Begin from the powers actually transferred and the contact actually achieved. A player outside that contact sees a vulnerable combatant and a changing enemy, not a shared view of the memories.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Izuku witnesses Tenko's family tragedy and reaches toward the child nobody helped. Present those memories through abandonment, grief, and the attempt to offer a hand rather than graphic spectacle. Nana and the remaining vestiges participate only within their established spiritual connection. All For One's manipulation becomes clear to the participants: he shaped Tenko's life, removed his original Quirk, and arranged the destructive ability that became Decay. As Tenko's inner defenses change, All For One's remaining presence reasserts control of Shigaraki's body.

Izuku returns to physical awareness without both arms in the default course. His full inherited power has been sacrificed, leaving residual embers rather than a complete set of usable Quirks. Keep an opportunity for a credible intervention to alter the contact, injury, or takeover; do not restore the default by silently undoing it. The armless Izuku needs immediate shielding and stabilization. The enemy's changed control must be established through behavior and what participants can communicate, not a universal announcement of private history.

By place: Mount Fuji Battlefield stages the physical emergency and any legitimately shared inward contact. Musutafu General Hospital prepares catastrophic-injury care. U.A. Academy, Okuto Island, Kamino Ward, Gunga Mountain Villa, Jaku City, and Takoba Municipal Stadium receive requests for reinforcement or medical support through surviving communications. A remote player can secure a route, prepare stabilization, or challenge a false victory report without gaining access to Tenko's memories.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B shield Izuku if physically present; General Studies routes aid; Support prepares stabilization equipment. Management prevents false victory claims and Faculty coordinates rescue. Licensed Sidekick protects casualties; Licensed Pro Hero delays the controlled body. League of Villains Recruit chooses between Tomura and All For One; Independent Villain exploits or opposes the takeover. Vigilante seeks extraction access; Civilian Life assists evacuation and emergency reception.

The event is complete when Izuku's actual injuries and remaining power, the enemy body's controlling identity, and the knowledge limited to the inward encounter are explicit.

eri_horn_and_open_gates.title: From Aizawa
eri_horn_and_open_gates.beats:
In day 405's final rescue phase, Izuku Midoriya needs protection at Mount Fuji Battlefield while Shota Aizawa and Present Mic try to reach their old friend within Kurogiri. Their contact begins wherever the earlier portal disruption actually left them; establish any journey before an arrival. Elsewhere, Eri remains a protected child with Ectoplasm and the shelter staff, determined to help without entering the battle.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Aizawa and Present Mic reach the traces of Shirakumo beneath Kurogiri's conditioning. Gates open to bring available heroes from fronts whose fighting has genuinely ended. Eri has entrusted her severed horn and its stored Rewind energy to the rescue effort. Its delivery restores Izuku's recently lost arms, allowing the gathered fighters to protect him and prepare an advance. This repairs the recent bodily loss; it does not restore the sacrificed One For All inheritance.

Keep Eri's contribution child-safe and brief. The injury is not reenacted in graphic detail or offered as a procedure for the player to perform. Adults take responsibility for her care, comfort, and medical assessment, and she stays away from combat. A player can support a safer established alternative, protect the delivery, or persuade Kurogiri to hold a passage. Restored arms do not erase every accumulated injury. Gates admit only the people actually reached and ready; a hospitalized or still-engaged fighter requires a real decision and viable extraction before joining.

By place: Mount Fuji Battlefield stages Izuku's treatment and arriving reinforcements; U.A. Academy stages the protected handoff and remaining personnel. Takoba Municipal Stadium releases Sero's team only after Gashly is resolved. Okuto Island, Kamino Ward, Gunga Mountain Villa, and Jaku City provide surviving fighters only through established gates. Musutafu General Hospital protects patients and receives Eri for assessment after a safe handover. Remote participants can coordinate arrival checks, care, or a reachable delivery leg.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B enter available gates; General Studies supports the shelter handoff; Support preserves rescue supplies. Management checks arrivals and Faculty reaches Shirakumo and directs deployment. Licensed Sidekick shields Izuku; Licensed Pro Hero engages the enemy. League of Villains Recruit can influence Kurogiri's loyalties; Independent Villain chooses passage or withdrawal. Vigilante joins permitted rescue access; Civilian Life comforts Eri and assists evacuees.

The event is complete when the horn's actual result, Eri's care, Kurogiri's response, and the identities and positions of arriving reinforcements are established.

everyone_clears_the_way.title: The Last Smash
everyone_clears_the_way.beats:
At day 405's conclusion, the surviving reinforcements face the body controlled by All For One at Mount Fuji Battlefield. Izuku Midoriya can advance only with the power and bodily condition actually left to him. In the default course his arms are restored and only One For All's embers remain. The gathered fighters create a route while broadcasts carry the visible struggle to people far beyond the battlefield.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: classmates and heroes combine their abilities to shield Izuku and carry him through successive attacks. Their contributions create physical openings rather than restoring his lost inheritance. Kurogiri tries once more to protect Tomura. Bakugo, still grievously injured, reaches the final confrontation through an established approach and destroys that obstruction. Izuku's last attack joins resistance from within to destroy All For One's remaining presence and end Shigaraki's life. Tomura entrusts Izuku with a message for Spinner before disappearing.

Keep Shigaraki and Kurogiri reachable until their deaths are actually established. The player can contribute an opening, attempt a rescue that separates Tomura from the controlling presence, protect Kurogiri, surrender, or oppose the advance. Neither death is a required payment for victory. A successful rescue changes the aftermath and custody. The private final message reaches Spinner only if someone later delivers it. Bakugo's return requires a viable route and cannot undo a prior medical extraction or incapacity without explanation. At the end, fading embers remain distinct from the full inherited power.

By place: Mount Fuji Battlefield stages the final advance and immediate rescue handover. U.A. Academy maintains surviving communications; Musutafu General Hospital prepares mass casualty reception. Okuto Island, Kamino Ward, Gunga Mountain Villa, Jaku City, and Takoba Municipal Stadium receive verified outcomes and continue local rescue. A distant player can keep a broadcast, medical route, or trapped group alive while the decisive action occurs elsewhere; watching does not place them inside the final exchange.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B create a concrete opening; General Studies maintains rescue communications; Support sustains equipment. Management preserves accurate reporting and Faculty coordinates the advance. Licensed Sidekick protects wounded; Licensed Pro Hero clears the route. League of Villains Recruit chooses Tomura, All For One, surrender, or defection; Independent Villain makes a final intervention. Vigilante rescues at the perimeter; Civilian Life helps responders and stranded people.

The event is complete when the enemy's final condition, Izuku's survival and remaining power, all established deaths or rescues, and the immediate medical handover are explicit.

hospital_after_victory.title: What Did We Save?
hospital_after_victory.beats:
Morning at Musutafu General Hospital: Izuku Midoriya, Katsuki Bakugo, and All Might remain under treatment, while Ryu Yoshida explains what recovery permits. Izuku has fresh scars, bandages, and a partly shaved head; Katsuki faces serious damage to his arm and heart. International assistance begins reaching Jaku City, where residents and relief crews clear routes before rebuilding homes.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: in a private bedside conversation, Izuku admits that reaching Tomura Shigaraki did not keep him alive. All Might recognizes the rescue Izuku attempted without pretending the loss disappears. Katsuki learns privately that Izuku surrendered his inherited power and has only its remaining embers; his grief breaks through his usual aggression. Offered alternatives for his damaged arm, he chooses difficult rehabilitation rather than abandoning its use. None of these conversations gives the public access to One For All. If Tomura survived an earlier intervention, their conversation instead faces his actual condition and accountability; a living person is not mourned as dead.

At Musutafu General Hospital, the party can visit with consent, ask about restrictions, or secure a rehabilitation appointment. At Jaku City, a relief delivery needs a safe unloading point and an identified household to receive it. Reports connect the two places; patients do not leave their beds to join a work crew. Existing deaths and injuries remain consequential.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B offer permitted company; General Studies handles relief intake; Support adapts recovery aids; Management assigns donations; Faculty arranges interrupted study; Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero secure reconstruction routes. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain face an individual interview or a choice about exploiting the damage; Vigilante reaches overlooked residents; Civilian Life repairs a home or supports a patient. Custody and medical restrictions govern access.

The event is complete when the central survivors' conditions are confirmed and the party's treatment or relief assignment has a responsible contact and a concrete next step.

delayed_graduation_new_class.title: The Academy Opens Again
delayed_graduation_new_class.beats:
June 1 at U.A. Academy: Mirio Togata, Tamaki Amajiki, and Nejire Hado gather with their graduating year for the ceremony the crisis postponed. Shota Aizawa waits afterward with Yuga Aoyama and Hitoshi Shinso as returning students discover how much their classroom will change. Graduation is a celebration with visible absences, injuries, and unfinished rebuilding outside.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the Big Three graduate and leave student life for professional work. Yuga voluntarily withdraws despite his classmates' willingness to welcome him back. He intends to face his responsibility and earn a fresh route toward becoming a hero; departure is neither an erasure of coercion nor a declaration that he can never return to that ambition. Hitoshi enters the Hero Course and joins Class A. Izuku Midoriya's cohort begins its delayed second year, and the parallel Class B advances with it.

Give the party time for a farewell, a practical offer of support, or a question about transfer requirements before the new homeroom settles. Yuga can hear a different proposal and choose differently if the conversation earns it. His family's private history is not recited to the ceremony audience. Classroom doors and familiar meeting places remain recognizable, but students and teachers speak of Class 2-A and Class 2-B. The graduating seniors no longer receive student assignments.

By Path at U.A. Academy: Class 1-A and Class 1-B take their new places without losing the friendships formed in the first year; General Studies can discuss a real transfer route; Support issues repaired equipment; Management helps run the ceremony; Faculty sets a recovery curriculum. Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero offer graduates placements. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain receive an authorized account or decide whether to approach the restored institution; Vigilante considers lawful training; Civilian Life attends as an invited guest or supports resumed education. Detention never becomes an invitation to campus.

The event is complete when the seniors' graduation, Yuga's departure or agreed alternative, Hitoshi's placement, and the party's new academic or professional status are stated.

todoroki_final_visit.title: Soba
todoroki_final_visit.beats:
At Musutafu General Hospital, a guarded medical room opens for the Todoroki family's short visit. Dabi, publicly known as Toya Todoroki, survives inside life-support equipment. Endeavor arrives with Rei Todoroki, Fuyumi Todoroki, Natsuo Todoroki, and Shoto Todoroki. The appointment ends when the medical staff say it must; the family's need to speak cannot extend Toya's physical endurance.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Endeavor retires from hero work and commits to facing Toya repeatedly rather than treating this visit as a final duty. His burns, lost arm, and limited mobility remain visible. Toya is alive but terminally injured, and speech is painfully limited. Natsuo explains that he will marry and build a life separate from his father. Endeavor accepts that boundary without demanding an invitation or forgiveness. Fuyumi and Rei retain their own choices instead of being assigned responsibility for repairing him.

Shoto uses the little time available to ask what food Toya likes. The answer, soba, gives the brothers a small point of recognition; Toya's halting apology does not settle the family's history. Allow a player intervention to change who speaks first, obtain a later visit, or support a relative's boundary. Medical help can be pursued honestly, but no conversation automatically cures Toya, and no death occurs merely because this scene ends. If earlier rescue changed his injuries, the family faces that real prognosis.

By Path at Musutafu General Hospital: Class 1-A supports Shoto with his consent; Class 1-B covers recovery duties; General Studies helps arrange visits; Support improves accessibility; Management protects privacy; Faculty grants compassionate absence. Licensed Sidekick guards authorized access; Licensed Pro Hero addresses the retired agency's transition through communications. League of Villains Recruit may request contact or testimony; Independent Villain must choose what to do with information lawfully received; Vigilante discourages harassment; Civilian Life supports a relative. Nobody gains family-room access solely by choosing a Path.

The event is complete when the visit closes, Toya's current medical condition is clear, and the family's separate commitments and boundaries are stated.

pardons_and_accountability.title: A Different Commission
pardons_and_accountability.beats:
At Musutafu Police Headquarters, Naomasa Tsukauchi meets Gentle Criminal and La Brava as their individual dispositions arrive. At Musutafu General Hospital, Hawks visits Lady Nagant under custody and medical supervision. Hero Public Safety Commission Headquarters begins receiving instructions for a different leadership. Overhaul remains separately detained; cooperation during the crisis has not erased his crimes.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Gentle Criminal and La Brava receive pardons for their decisive help and reunite. Their relief belongs to two specific decisions, not a general amnesty. Lady Nagant declines immediate release, choosing to watch whether the promised reforms become real before stepping outside. Hawks, whose Quirk was stolen, takes leadership of the Commission and must answer with policy rather than restored wings.

Separately, Overhaul's recovered former boss confronts him about the harm done to Eri and insists that accountability reach beyond wanting his own forgiveness. The boss appears only through the account of that supervised encounter. Eri is not summoned, asked to comfort her abuser, or made the price of his rehabilitation. Overhaul remains armless and subject to custody. The party can pursue an individual review, challenge an unsupported condition, or help a survivor refuse contact; changed decisions require an actual hearing or agreement.

At Musutafu Police Headquarters, play the pardon notices or a custody interview. At Musutafu General Hospital, keep Nagant's decision private unless she authorizes its release. At Hero Public Safety Commission Headquarters, the party can seek a revised duty or a concrete answer about oversight. Travel and permission separate these encounters.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B support affected friends; General Studies assists reintegration; Support supplies recovery aids; Management asks about transparency; Faculty protects Eri's interests. Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero clarify revised duties. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain seek individual terms or choose continued opposition; Vigilante explores lawful service; Civilian Life pursues victim support. A favorable decision for someone else never automatically changes the party's legal status.

The event is complete when the named people's legal positions and the party's own request, refusal, or response have definite answers.

spinner_hears_the_message.title: His Story Was Real
spinner_hears_the_message.beats:
In a guarded patient room at Musutafu General Hospital, Spinner receives an authorized visit from Izuku Midoriya. Naomasa Tsukauchi supervises access without turning a medical conversation into a press event. Spinner remains affected by the extra Quirks imposed on him, and his condition limits the visit. Outside, coverage of Tomura Shigaraki offers a much simpler story than the one either visitor carries.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Spinner rejects an account that reduces his friend to a monster whose disappearance resolves everything. Izuku delivers Tomura's final message: he fought to destroy until the end. Spinner remembers friendship, games, and a cause that gave his isolated life direction. His anger at Izuku does not disappear because the messenger listens. Izuku acknowledges the person he failed to preserve without denying the destruction Tomura caused.

Spinner resolves to tell the League's story himself. Help him obtain a permitted means to write, challenge a misleading summary, or let him refuse further conversation. His intention is not an endorsement of the heroes, and publication is a future undertaking rather than a book already on sale. Izuku does not explain vestige encounters or the mechanics of One For All to spectators. If Tomura survived, this becomes a message about his actual condition and contact wishes; it cannot become a false final testament.

By Path at Musutafu General Hospital: Class 1-A and Class 1-B accompany Izuku only if invited or speak with him afterward; General Studies helps authorized correspondence; Support meets medical communication needs; Management preserves testimony with consent; Faculty supervises access. Licensed Sidekick provides an escort and Licensed Pro Hero considers practical rehabilitation. League of Villains Recruit can offer a remembered encounter; Independent Villain may dispute a claim with evidence; Vigilante confronts the limits of a victory narrative; Civilian Life asks how reporting treats the people involved. Detained parties receive a separate interview or permitted correspondence, never an unexplained release.

The event is complete when Spinner receives or expressly refuses the message, the visit closes safely, and the resulting disagreement or commitment to tell his story is clear.

ochaco_after_toga.title: The Girl Who Loves Smiles
ochaco_after_toga.beats:
At U.A. Academy, reconstruction work ends and Ochaco Uraraka maintains a bright manner until she leaves Heights Alliance alone. Izuku Midoriya notices the strain. At Beast's Forest, Ochaco reaches a quiet overlook beside the Forest Trailhead, away from the relief crews. Her healing wound and exhausted composure matter more here than public praise for the battle.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Izuku follows by an established route and finds Ochaco grieving Himiko Toga. In private, Ochaco explains that Toga gave her blood to save her and died; surviving does not make Ochaco feel she succeeded in saving the other girl. Izuku admits his own grief over Tomura Shigaraki and affirms that Ochaco has repeatedly helped him. Their classmates arrive to care for someone who has been caring for everyone else.

Give silence, tears, anger, and the choice to accept company room to occur. The party can notice earlier, offer a different trusted companion, or help keep the gathering small. Ochaco need not recount an intimate memory to every arriving classmate. If Toga or Tomura survived earlier intervention, the conversation faces their real medical or legal circumstances; gratitude and fear can replace a false bereavement. Nobody is made happy on demand, and one evening does not finish recovery.

At U.A. Academy, play the missed check-in, arrange relief from tomorrow's work, or receive a consented account afterward. At Beast's Forest, approach without surrounding Ochaco and agree on company for the return. A remote party cannot overhear the conversation through a general relief channel.

By Path: Class 1-A reaches out personally; Class 1-B covers work; General Studies supports peer contact; Support accommodates injuries; Management protects privacy; Faculty offers care without demanding a confession. Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero cover duties and support rehabilitation. League of Villains Recruit may mourn Toga separately or request correspondence; Independent Villain can offer relevant testimony; Vigilante can share rescue-related grief if welcomed; Civilian Life provides ordinary company. Custody restricts contact without invalidating grief.

The event is complete when Ochaco is no longer isolated and a trusted companion, next check-in, and manageable recovery duty are agreed.

someone_takes_the_childs_hand.title: This Time, Someone Stops
someone_takes_the_childs_hand.beats:
In Musutafu Station District, a frightened boy emerges from the Back Alleys into a neighborhood beginning to enjoy ordinary life again. Koki Terumoto has escaped confinement and neglect; he needs safety and care before questions about his past. Izuku Midoriya and Ochaco Uraraka are nearby, but the first person with a chance to respond is an elderly resident.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the woman who once walked past Tenko Shimura notices this child and stops. Her earlier failure is her own memory, not knowledge automatically shared by everyone present. She speaks gently, offers a hand rather than demanding obedience, and asks the neighbors to help. Koki's distress begins to ease because somebody sees him before treating him as a threat. Izuku and Ochaco support the response instead of replacing the civilian's decision with a display of hero power.

The party can be the first person to stop, fetch water, clear space, or call qualified help. Keep the woman's contribution if someone else reaches Koki first: several people can choose care. His Darkness Quirk and visible fear never make him a villain or justify a combat scene. Describe the abuse only as much as needed to arrange safeguarding. Koki may decline touch or struggle to answer; neither response counts as ingratitude.

Ryu Yoshida can receive him at Musutafu General Hospital after an actual escorted journey. Before departure, identify the responsible escort and accepting clinician aloud; neighbors do not send an unaccompanied child away with an address. The initial medical handover remains separate from deciding permanent care, which needs a protected assessment.

By Path at Musutafu Station District: Class 1-A and Class 1-B help without taking over; General Studies contacts care services; Support meets immediate practical needs; Management explains available help; Faculty arranges suitable educational contact. Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero secure safeguarding and follow-up. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain face a choice to protect a vulnerable person, with any threat answered promptly; Vigilante helps residents act; Civilian Life can be the person who stops. No Path makes the child a recruit.

The event is complete when Koki is safe with an identified responsible adult, an accepting care provider, and a definite escorted handover.

embers_through_graduation.title: Finish What We Started
embers_through_graduation.beats:
At U.A. Academy on March 25, the cohort gathers for graduation after its third year. Izuku Midoriya, Katsuki Bakugo, Ochaco Uraraka, Shoto Todoroki, and Hitoshi Shinso wait in the Upper-Year Classrooms while Shota Aizawa checks the ceremony preparations. At Hero Agency Row, completed placements return final assessments. The party has one remaining ambition to account for before the next stage of life.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: the ceremony draws together short scenes from the years since June's recovery. Revisit a rebuilding shift, a demanding training exercise, a placement setback, and a project brought to completion. Let the party choose which goal those scenes test and show the consequence of its actual work. Class A and Class B progress through the Academy's three-year course; other students and professionals pursue their own routes rather than being assigned the same diploma.

Privately, Izuku continues using the embers of One For All until they fade. By this transition he is Quirkless again, but the education, relationships, and instinct to help remain. Friends can support his next decision without inventing a cure. Return to the graduation ceremony, give the shared achievement and missing people time to matter, and let farewell become an agreement about staying connected. Yuga Aoyama follows the separate route established at his departure; he is not silently restored to the roster. Neither past deaths nor permanent disabilities disappear during the passage of years.

By Path at U.A. Academy and Hero Agency Row: Class 1-A and Class 1-B complete training and placements; General Studies qualifies for a chosen career; Support presents a working project; Management establishes professional practice; Faculty mentors graduates. Licensed Sidekick takes greater responsibility; Licensed Pro Hero develops an agency. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain face the actual outcome of custody, rehabilitation, or continued flight; Vigilante chooses a relationship with formal service; Civilian Life pursues recovery and personal ambitions. Invitations, travel, and legal status determine physical attendance.

The event is complete when graduation has concluded and the party's selected goal, qualification or unresolved obstacle, and graduation-era place in society are explicit.

teacher_deku_and_dai.title: Can I Become a Hero?
teacher_deku_and_dai.beats:
Eight years after the Final War, Izuku Midoriya finishes teaching at U.A. Academy. His former classmates now work as adult professionals, and invitations must fit their schedules. Kota Izumi and Koki Terumoto may visit the Library through supervised outreach; they have aged naturally and are still too young for this Academy's postsecondary entrance. At Tokyo Bayside Mall, Dai hesitates near All Might Statue Plaza with a question about his own future.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: after his teaching day, Izuku encounters Dai. The boy worries that Saucer, his modest disc-producing Quirk, cannot lead anywhere heroic. His immediate instinct to help another child gives Izuku something concrete to recognize. Izuku encourages him to prepare, study, and pursue the wish to help rather than measure his worth by spectacle. The statue honors the living, retired All Might; visiting it is not attending a funeral.

Izuku is Quirkless and finds meaning in teaching even while missing field work. Ochaco Uraraka expands Quirk counseling, Mezo Shoji opposes heteromorph discrimination, and Mirio Togata leads the professional rankings. Mei Hatsume develops support equipment, while Gentle Criminal and La Brava have built a technology enterprise. Their work shows a changed society with fewer emerging villains, not an end to rescue or disagreement. A difficult time-skip outcome for the party remains part of that society.

At U.A. Academy, play a lesson, supervised visit, or alumni conversation before an actual journey to the plaza. At Tokyo Bayside Mall, begin with Dai's hesitation and small helpful act. He remains a child: an educational route runs through secondary schooling before Academy admission, and encouragement grants no combat authority.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B return as alumni; General Studies demonstrates another career; Support discusses useful tools; Management offers guidance; Faculty teaches alongside Izuku. Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero arrange safe observation. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain respond from their established legal situation; Vigilante shares responsible experience; Civilian Life encourages a young neighbor.

The event is complete when Dai has a safe next step toward his ambition and the party's own future occupation, obligations, and relationships are stated.

deku_armor_return.title: Reach Out Again
deku_armor_return.beats:
Later that day at U.A. Academy, All Might interrupts Izuku Midoriya's departure with a carefully prepared case. Katsuki Bakugo and the former classmates behind the project are ready to welcome him back into field work. At Hero Agency Row, a response crew receives a call that can become the armor's first practical assignment once Izuku has accepted and checked it.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: All Might presents an advanced support suit built through years of research and the collective contributions of Izuku's classmates, with Katsuki central to the effort. Its development draws on the lessons of All Might's armored battle and the work of Mei Hatsume and an overseas collaborator. Their contribution reaches Izuku through the finished equipment and All Might's explanation.

Izuku accepts the gift and reaches for the chance to act beside his friends again. Give him time to ask what the suit can do, acknowledge the people who made it possible, and choose the first response. It supplies equipment, not One For All or a biological Quirk. His teaching remains a vocation rather than a consolation job discarded when something better appears. If the party has changed the project's funding, delivery, or acceptance, resolve those conditions honestly instead of declaring an unexplained finished suit.

At U.A. Academy, the party can join the handover, discuss maintenance, or arrange class coverage. At Hero Agency Row, prepare an actual departure and help with an ordinary rescue at the reported site; Izuku arrives only after the journey. Keep unfamiliar equipment within its demonstrated limits. No new national emergency is needed to make his return meaningful.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B welcome a former classmate; General Studies supports the mission; Support checks systems; Management coordinates resources; Faculty protects teaching obligations. Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero join or direct the response. League of Villains Recruit and Independent Villain react according to their established rehabilitation or opposition; Vigilante cooperates in rescue; Civilian Life receives help or supports the effort.

The event is complete when Izuku accepts or declines the armor and the resulting first field assignment, postponement, or alternative is resolved.

more_quirk_counseling.title: The Work After Rescue
more_quirk_counseling.beats:
Early June at U.A. Academy, Ochaco Uraraka and Tsuyu Asui prepare an outreach session in the Lecture Hall with Mirio Togata, Tamaki Amajiki, and Nejire Hado. Visiting children arrive with responsible adults. The work is ordinary and sustained: listen to how a child experiences a Quirk, offer a safe activity, and make it easier to ask for help before isolation hardens.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Ochaco's counseling initiative treats difference as something to understand rather than suppress through shame. Tsuyu offers clear reassurance, and the Big Three help children engage at their own pace. A hesitant participant needs an agreed follow-up, not applause for performing a power. The party can adapt an exercise, notice a child withdrawing, or help a caregiver find the next appointment. A session ends with a specific contact rather than a promise that every future difficulty is solved.

Privately, Ochaco has been dreaming of Himiko Toga intermittently for about a month. The dreams return her attention to a person whose death and affection still matter, and to wishes she finds easier to set aside than express. Present any dream as Ochaco's private memory or sleeping experience, never as an apparition the room can see. Toga does not return to life. If earlier intervention saved her, Ochaco's dreams draw on their actual relationship and unresolved circumstances instead of insisting on bereavement.

At U.A. Academy, separate a public activity from any confidential conversation: consent determines whether the party learns about an individual child's concern or Ochaco's feelings. Outreach guests remain children and do not become Academy students simply by visiting. No child is asked to recount abuse for a hero's emotional benefit.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B join alumni outreach; General Studies offers educational help; Support adapts activities; Management sustains appointments; Faculty advises on teaching. Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero assist or sponsor visits. League of Villains Recruit contributes only through an established supervised rehabilitation role; Independent Villain may support community care without gaining access to children; Vigilante refers vulnerable residents; Civilian Life volunteers or attends with family.

The event is complete when the visit has a responsible follow-up for its children and Ochaco's unresolved personal concern remains clear without being exposed to the group.

more_class_reunion.title: Make Time for Each Other
more_class_reunion.beats:
Evening in Musutafu Station District, former Class A friends gather at the Family Restaurant to celebrate Shoto Todoroki reaching the number-two hero position. Katsuki Bakugo, Ochaco Uraraka, Tsuyu Asui, and Hitoshi Shinso trade news while Izuku Midoriya finishes work at U.A. Academy before traveling to meet them. The gathering makes room for the whole former class, including Yuga Aoyama through his separately earned route.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: professional schedules finally overlap long enough for a celebration. Shoto remains matter-of-fact about the achievement; friends bring humor, changed appearances, and stories of lives that no longer share one dorm timetable. Mirio Togata remains the leading hero. Other rankings enter conversation only if someone actually knows and states them; no complete table is supplied simply because the subject arises.

Katsuki's blunt offer of work and questioning of Izuku's priorities give Izuku room to affirm that he wants to keep teaching while also using the armor. Declining an agency role is not declining friendship. Their conversation presses him to recognize the people and wishes he especially values rather than leaving every relationship at the same polite distance. The party can make time for an old friend, repair a neglected collaboration, or choose an honest boundary without the evening becoming a compulsory romantic performance.

At U.A. Academy, finish the immediate obligation and arrange an actual departure or send regrets. At Musutafu Station District, play the meal, a conversation apart from the table, and plans for meeting again. Attendance follows established friendship or a real invitation; venue work offers a separate perspective without access to private confidences. A detained party can receive authorized correspondence rather than appear at the celebration.

By Path: Class 1-A and Class 1-B reconnect as alumni; General Studies attends through friendship; Support discusses collaboration; Management helps arrangements; Faculty meets adult colleagues. Licensed Sidekick and Licensed Pro Hero arrange duty coverage. League of Villains Recruit, Independent Villain, and Vigilante choose contact or distance consistent with their actual relationships and legal standing; Civilian Life joins as a friend or works at the venue.

The event is complete when the celebration ends and the party renews, changes, or deliberately declines one specific relationship.

more_choose_a_personal_future.title: More
more_choose_a_personal_future.beats:
Night in Musutafu Station District: the reunion breaks up outside the Family Restaurant, and friends begin their separate journeys. Izuku Midoriya lingers while Ochaco Uraraka walks toward the Convenience Store Corner. Years of work and genuine affection have still left things unsaid. There is time for one of them to turn back before the ordinary evening ends.

The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Izuku recognizes that wanting to see everyone does not express everything he feels. He catches up with Ochaco and says plainly that he wants more time with her in particular. Ochaco acknowledges the same wish, and they reach for each other's hands. The movement is a mutual decision between adults, not a reward for winning the war or fulfilling an agency obligation.

Privately, what Toga meant to Ochaco helps her accept that her own happiness also deserves a place in her life. Any remembered encouragement belongs to Ochaco's experience, not a spirit speaking aloud to the street. Toga remains dead unless an earlier rescue changed that outcome. Neither party to this conversation gains automatic knowledge of the other's dreams or of private wartime encounters.
